Basis: Soil under the approach road of the old Amla river bridge in Afzalgarh slid; all vehicles were halted; 25+ villages and several Kadrabad-area colonies were cut off. No repair timeline given (Amar Ujala, 29 May 2026). No later update found. AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): इस बरसात में चौथी बार सड़कों पर बाढ़ का पानी लौटा
Voter says (English): Floodwater came back onto the roads for the fourth time this monsoon
Basis: Water flowing again on the state highway (Bahsuma-Thakurdwara) and flood-affected area roads; the report says it is the fourth time this monsoon. Datelined Jaleelpur; Jaleelpur's AC is not confirmed as AC 19 (district-level).

Survey statement (Hindi): हमारे विधायक और चेयरमैन ने अब तक बहुत अच्छा काम किया है
Voter says (English): The local MLA and chairman have done very good work so far
Basis: Voter Shahreen (शहरीन) said the local MLA and chairman have done very good work so far (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice praise of leaders, not a named project.

Survey statement (Hindi): यहां काफी काम हुआ है, कुछ हद तक चीजें बदली हैं
Voter says (English): A lot of work has been done here, and some changes are visible
Basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said a lot of work has been done; voter Preet Kumar Chauhan said things have changed to some extent, though expectations were not fully met (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): हमारे कॉलेज का स्पोर्ट्स बहुत अच्छा है
Voter says (English): The college's sports facilities are very good
Basis: Voter Matiha Zaidi said the sports facilities of her college are very good (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). She also praised her teachers; that part is not quoted here.

Survey statement (Hindi): उत्तर प्रदेश की सरकार से कोई परेशानी नहीं
Voter says (English): There is no trouble with the state government
Basis: Dr. N.P. Singh said there is no trouble with the Uttar Pradesh government (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice view, not a survey, and not a delivered benefit.

Survey statement (Hindi): धामपुर में सखी सेंटर का स्टाफ तैनात है, पर अभी खुला नहीं
Voter says (English): Staff are appointed for the Sakhi centre in Dhampur, but it is not open yet
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (25 Mar 2026): Sakhi One Stop Centre unit-2 at the 100-bed hospital campus on Nagina Road, Dhampur; five women appointed through outsourcing; centre not yet inaugurated, launch expected from April. Weakest positive: a sourced staffing step, not an open service, and no later report confirms it opened.

Survey statement (Hindi): काफी काम हुआ, पर यहां पानी की समस्या आज भी बनी हुई है
Voter says (English): There is still a water problem here despite the work done
Basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said there is a water problem even though a lot of work has been done (Dhampur town reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Dhampur Municipal Board also approved a Rs 1 crore drinking water pipeline as a planned item, not a completed one (Amar Ujala, 7 Jan 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): चीनी मिल समय पर भुगतान नहीं करेगी तो हम उसे गन्ना नहीं देंगे
Voter says (English): If a sugar mill does not pay on time, we will not give it our cane
Basis: District-level, not Dhampur-specific: Amar Ujala (Bijnor, 4 Oct 2026) reports BKU (Arajneeti)'s 'no payment, no cane' campaign against the Bilai sugar mill in Bijnor district, and a demand that its cane area be allotted to mills that pay on time. The dues amount is not stated in that article. Bilai is not among the areas listed for Dhampur AC on Wikipedia.

Survey statement (Hindi): बरसात में सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है, आवागमन में दिक्कत होती है
Voter says (English): Roads get waterlogged in the monsoon and transport gets disrupted
Basis: Voter Rachit Kumar said roads were waterlogged in this and the previous monsoon, causing transport trouble (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): जल निगम का काम जर्जर है, किसी गांव में टंकी पूरी नहीं हुई
Voter says (English): The Jal Nigam work here is dilapidated, and no village water tank has been completed
Basis: Voter Chaudhary Kaviraj said a structure dug by Jal Nigam is lying dilapidated and that no water tank has been completed in any village so far (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). The article's wording is about a dug structure/drain linked to the tank; the tank itself is not described in detail.

Survey statement (Hindi): खाद की किल्लत है, किसान परेशान हैं
Voter says (English): There is a shortage of fertiliser and farmers are struggling
Basis: Farmer Mahendra Pal Singh raised a shortage of fertiliser (Dhampur reporting, Amar Ujala, 31 Aug 2026). Single-voice view, no place named, so not AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): मेरे रिश्तेदार को मकान मिला है, राशन और किसान कार्ड भी बने हैं
Voter says (English): My relative got a house, and ration and farmer cards have also been made
Basis: An unnamed Nehtaur resident said a relative received a house and that ration and farmer cards were issued (Amar Ujala, Nehtaur (Bijnor) byline, 1 Sep 2026). Benefit delivered; the speaker is not named.

Survey statement (Hindi): सड़कें भी सुधरी हैं
Voter says (English): Roads have also improved
Basis: A trader said roads have improved (Amar Ujala, Nehtaur (Bijnor) byline, 1 Sep 2026). No specific road is named in the article.

Survey statement (Hindi): बालिका विद्यालय की इमारत पहले खराब थी, अब सुधार हुआ है
Voter says (English): The girls' school building was in bad shape earlier, and now it has been improved
Basis: A trader said education has improved, citing a girls' school building that was dilapidated and has been upgraded (Amar Ujala, Nehtaur (Bijnor) byline, 1 Sep 2026). The school is not named in the article; the quote is cut short in the source.

Survey statement (Hindi): अब नकदी लेकर चलने में डर नहीं लगता, सुरक्षा बेहतर है
Voter says (English): Now carrying cash does not feel unsafe, and security has become better
Basis: A trader said the security situation has improved; another trader said traders now feel secure carrying cash, where they used to feel unsafe (Amar Ujala, Nehtaur (Bijnor) byline, 1 Sep 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): बालावाली से नहटौर तक फिर बसें चलने लगी हैं
Voter says (English): Buses to Nehtaur from Balawali are running again
Basis: Direct bus service was restored: 12 buses from Balawali to Nehtaur started on 24 Feb 2023 via Mandawar, Kiratpur and Shadipur; passengers change buses at Kiratpur because the Kiratpur market road is narrow (Amar Ujala, Bijnor, 24 Feb 2023). Only the ARTO is quoted; no resident is quoted. This is a 2023 source; continued operation after 2023 is not verified.

Survey statement (Hindi): नहटौर का रेल फाटक कई दिन से बंद है, लोग बहुत परेशान हैं
Voter says (English): The Nahtaur railway gate has been closed for many days and people are very troubled
Basis: Nahtaur road railway gate, inside the AC (Nehtaur municipal board per Wikipedia extent). On 22 Mar 2026 the gate had been shut for about 15 days for track repair; residents said it had not reopened after the first closure date of 12 March, and railway officials said work was on a war footing with no reopening date (Amar Ujala, Dhampur dateline, 22 Mar 2026). On 27 Apr 2026 it was reported fully closed for 20 days for track repair; residents said commuters must use the overbridge in the heat to reach SDM, CO, tehsil and other offices across the tracks, and railway officers gave no reopening date (Amar Ujala, Dhampur dateline, 27 Apr 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): नहटौर का बस स्टैंड बहुत जर्जर हो गया है
Voter says (English): The bus stand is very dilapidated
Basis: Nahtaur town bus stand, inside the AC (Nehtaur municipal board; article datelined Nahtaur). Amar Ujala (9 Apr 2026) calls it dilapidated (जर्जर). The government plans PPP/DBFOT redevelopment with a waiting hall, commercial complex, CCTV, digital boards and parking, approved under a statewide 49-stand scheme; no start or completion date is given. No resident is quoted; the complaint is the reporter's description.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिना वजह बिजली बहुत कटती है, इसे रोका जाए
Voter says (English): Power is cut too often for no reason, so it should be stopped
Basis: District-level, not Nehtaur-specific: BKU (Tikait) workers' memorandum to the Dhampur tehsildar (Dhampur dateline, 10 Jun 2026) demanded stopping 'अंधाधुंध' (indiscriminate) power cuts. No Nehtaur village or town is named.

Survey statement (Hindi): आवारा पशुओं को पकड़कर गोशाला भिजवाया जाए
Voter says (English): Stray animals should be caught and sent to cow shelters
Basis: District-level, not Nehtaur-specific: the same BKU memorandum to the Dhampur tehsildar (10 Jun 2026) demanded catching stray animals and sending them to gaushalas. No Nehtaur place is named.

Survey statement (Hindi): गांव के पास गुलदार घूमता रहा, लोग डरे रहे
Voter says (English): A leopard kept roaming near the village and people stayed scared
Basis: Aaj Tak (Bijnor dateline, 6 Sep 2026): a leopard roamed Sadaruddinagar village, placed in the 'Nahtaur area' (नहटौर क्षेत्र), for several days; the forest department set a cage and trapped it about five days later. The village is not named in the Wikipedia extent text, so AC membership is unconfirmed and it is not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

Survey statement (Hindi): सड़कों से अब आना-जाना काफी आसान हो गया है
Voter says (English): Roads have made travel much easier now
Basis: Local resident Neeraj, quoted in Amar Ujala's Bijnor Vidhan Sabha issues feature, says road connectivity has improved well; bridges, highway and road building eased travel (Bijnor city feature, not a road-by-road report)

Survey statement (Hindi): दस में से नौ मिलों ने समय पर गन्ने का पैसा दिया
Voter says (English): Nine of the ten mills paid the cane money on time
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala says nine of the district's ten sugar mills have paid cane prices on time; only Bilai mill is still owing, making partial payments

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर के चौराहे अब सुंदर हो गए हैं
Voter says (English): The city's intersections have become beautiful now
Basis: Amar Ujala (9 Sep 2026) reports Shastri, Jaji and Kisan chowks in Bijnor city redone and beautified (headline 'चमक गए चौराहे'); the same report says the roads leading to them are still damaged

Survey statement (Hindi): 137 स्वास्थ्य उपकेंद्रों को गुणवत्ता प्रमाण पत्र मिला
Voter says (English): 137 health sub-centres in the district have got the NQAS quality certificate
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala (16 Jul 2026) says 137 health sub-centres in Bijnor district received the NQAS certificate; district ranked 4th in state and 1st in division; CMO Dr Kaushalendra Singh named

Survey statement (Hindi): विधायक ने हमारे मुद्दे ऊपर तक उठाए, कुछ काम भी हुए
Voter says (English): The MLA raised our issues at the top level, and some work has happened
Basis: In the Amar Ujala feature, an unnamed resident says the MLA raised local issues at state level and development work followed; other residents said some work is still pending (single feature, vague claim)

Survey statement (Hindi): बिलाई चीनी मिल पर 41.98 करोड़ गन्ना भुगतान बकाया है
Voter says (English): Sugarcane dues of Rs 41.98 crore are still pending at Bilai sugar mill
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala says Bilai mill owes Rs 41.98 crore and is making partial payments; farmers plan a sit-in from 15 Oct and have collected affidavits. The source places the mill only in Bijnor district; whether it lies in AC 22 is unconfirmed

Survey statement (Hindi): नगीना, चक्कर रोड पर गड्ढे हैं, जजी चौक का डिवाइडर टूटा है
Voter says (English): There are potholes on Nagina and Chakkar roads, and the Jaji Chowk divider is broken
Basis: Bijnor city (Bijnor MB, inside AC extent): Amar Ujala reports Nagina Road badly potholed, Chakkar Road potholes filled with bricks, and Shastri to Jaji Chowk divider broken with vehicles climbing it at night; EE Hemant Pratap Singh said Nagina and Chakkar roads will be repaired after rains

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में आवास विकास और नई बस्ती में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): Awas Vikas and Nai Basti get waterlogged in rain
Basis: Bijnor city (inside AC extent): Amar Ujala reports Awas Vikas and Nai Basti waterlogged in rain; EO Megha Gupta said water is being pumped out. The article's '30 years' waterlogging remark refers to Kiratpur and is not used here

Survey statement (Hindi): दारानगर गंज वाली सड़क का चौड़ीकरण तारकोल न मिलने से रुका है
Voter says (English): The Daranagar Ganj road widening has stopped for want of bitumen
Basis: Bijnor to Daranagar Ganj stretch (about 10 km, 7 m to 10 m widening, about Rs 18 crore); Dara Nagar is named in the AC extent on Wikipedia. Amar Ujala says Executive Engineer Hemant Pratap Singh said work stopped for lack of bitumen, pits dug on both sides are troubling drivers

Survey statement (Hindi): मंडावर में बनी नई नाली ढह गई, घटिया सामान का आरोप है
Voter says (English): A new drain built in Mandawar collapsed, and people allege substandard material was used
Basis: Mandawar NP (KC Mandawar and Mandawar NP are in AC extent per Wikipedia): about 14 drains costing roughly Rs 1 crore under urban drainage scheme; one drain near Bijli Ghar fully collapsed; residents allege substandard material; SDM Smriti Mishra said an inquiry will be conducted (allegation, not proven)

Survey statement (Hindi): चांदपुर स्टेशन पर मसूरी और गढ़वाल एक्सप्रेस रुकती हैं
Voter says (English): Mussoorie and Garhwal Express stop at Chandpur station
Basis: Wikipedia (undated; no date given for train service): Chandpur Siau station, Chandpur, Bijnor; Mussoorie Express, Garhwal Express and Lucknow-Chandigarh Express stop there. Station is in Chandpur town (Chandpur MB), which the AC extent lists, so inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): पालिका ने नाले साफ कराए, बच्चे अब आसानी से स्कूल जाते हैं
Voter says (English): The municipality got the drains cleared, and children can now go to school more easily
Basis: Bhaskar (8 Sep 2026): after an SDM Chandpur order (21 Aug 2026), Chandpur Municipal Council's EO sent a team; drains and nalas cleared, water drained from the main road at Kakrala Bhagwantpur, where 2-3 ft of water had stood. Students can travel to school more easily, per three school principals' complaints. AC membership of the village is not confirmed (Chandpur tehsil; the SDM and municipal action are local).

Survey statement (Hindi): चांदपुर से दिल्ली, लखनऊ और रुड़की की ट्रेन मिल जाती है
Voter says (English): Trains to Delhi, Lucknow and Roorkee are available from Chandpur
Basis: Wikipedia (Chandpur, Bijnor; undated): railway connections to New Delhi, Lucknow, Saharanpur, Roorkee, Chandigarh, and direct bus services to New Delhi. Transport section is tagged as citing no sources (Sep 2022), so treat as weak. Town is inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): *चांदपुर में रोज़मर्रा की दुकानें और बाज़ार पास में मिल जाते हैं
Voter says (English): *Shops for daily needs and a market are close by in Chandpur town
Basis: Inference: no source found on Chandpur market facilities. Based only on the town being a municipal board (nagar palika parishad) with a population of 83,441 (2011 census, Wikipedia). Needs field check.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिले के 137 उपकेंद्रों को गुणवत्ता प्रमाण पत्र मिला है
Voter says (English): 137 health sub-centres in the district have quality certificates
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 Jul 2026): Bijnor ranks 4th in the state and 1st in its division for NQAS certificates; 137 health sub-centres in the district received the certificate, per CMO Dr. Kaushalendra Singh. District-level, not AC-specific. This is an official certificate, not a service voters can see, so it ranks last.

Survey statement (Hindi): बाढ़ से नौ गांव अब भी घिरे हैं, ट्रैक्टर ही सहारा है
Voter says (English): Nine villages are still surrounded by flood water, tractors are the only way out
Basis: Amar Ujala (3 Aug 2026), dateline Jalilpur: water in the Ganga khadar fell, but nine villages remain surrounded by water; movement is difficult, tractors are the main way to travel, and access roads Siyali-Dattiyana, Siyali-Sujatpur Khadar, Muzaffarpur Khadar-Dattiyana and Sujatpur Khadar-Dattiyana were damaged. Named villages (Dattiyana, Siyali, Kumariya, Raipur Khadar, etc.) are not confirmed inside the AC extent. District-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजली कटती है, जनरेटर में डीजल नहीं, डायलिसिस रुक जाता है
Voter says (English): Power cuts and no diesel in the generator stop dialysis at the district hospital
Basis: Quint Hindi (22 Jun 2025): at Bijnor district hospital a 26-year-old patient's dialysis stopped due to power cuts and no diesel in the generator for about a month, per his mother; DM Jasjeet Kaur acknowledged that diesel was needed during power cuts. Part of a wider UP power-cut story. District-level (Bijnor city hospital), not inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिलाई मिल पर गन्ने का बकाया है, किसान परेशान हैं
Voter says (English): Bilai sugar mill still owes cane money, farmers are upset
Basis: Amar Ujala (2 Oct 2026), Bijnor dateline: unpaid cane payment from the Bilai sugar mill is causing financial trouble for farmers; about 5,000 affidavits to be taken from farmers if dues stay unpaid. No amount stated. Mill's block and whether it is in the AC are not stated, so this is district-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): गांव में नाली नहीं, नाली का पानी सीधे जल स्रोतों में जाता है
Voter says (English): There is no drain in the village, and drain water goes straight into water bodies
Basis: onefivenine village directory (census-linked, undated; years mentioned are 2011 and 2021 copyright): Basera is in Chandpur tehsil, Jalilpur C.D. block, Bijnor; 'No Drainage System Available in this Village'; 'Drain water is discharged directly into water bodies'. AC membership unconfirmed: Basera is not in the AC extent's listed Kanungo circles or patwar circles. Directory entry, not news; needs field check.

Survey statement (Hindi): चीनी मिलों पर गन्ने का बकाया है, किसानों का पैसा अटका है
Voter says (English): Sugar mills have cane money pending and farmers are still waiting
Basis: The Quint (27 Sep 2019, old): farmers in Bijnor district say around nine sugar mills owe some Rs 500 crore, unpaid since 2018; the district cane officer was quoted saying FIRs would be registered. Mills not named; district-level and dated 2019. Kept only as background; no 2024-26 Chandpur mill source was found.

Survey statement (Hindi): अब दिल्ली-मेरठ नहीं जाना पड़ता, बिजनौर में ही इलाज हो रहा है
Voter says (English): Now treatment is available in Bijnor itself, no need to go to Delhi or Meerut
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala Bijnor ground report (21 Aug 2026) quotes Assistant Professor Amit Gupta of the Mahatma Vidur Autonomous State Medical College saying earlier district patients had to go to Delhi or Meerut; the article is read as saying treatment is now available in Bijnor.

Survey statement (Hindi): *बाईपास लगभग बन गया है, शहर के बाहर से गाड़ियां निकलेंगी
Voter says (English): *The bypass is nearly built, so vehicles will pass outside the city
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (21 Sep 2026) says the 8 km Bijnor bypass is 92% complete and NHAI SDO Ashish Sharma says it will be opened to vehicles by 15 October 2026; the report does not mention Noorpur or Chandpur, so its effect on this AC is not confirmed. Zee News Hindi (31 Dec 2024) says it will take Chandpur road and Noorpur road jams out of the city.

Survey statement (Hindi): *नूरपुर में पढ़ाई के लिए कई स्कूल और कॉलेज मिल जाते हैं
Voter says (English): *In Noorpur, many schools and colleges are available for study
Basis: Inference: Wikipedia's Noorpur town article says the town has a wide variety of schools and colleges, from government schools to high-fee private schools; students also travel to Moradabad and Bijnor for education. No details on condition or capacity, and no news report on local schools was found. Noorpur town is inside the AC per the Wikipedia AC extent (Noorpur MB).

Survey statement (Hindi): विदुर कुटी का सौंदर्यीकरण हो गया है
Voter says (English): Beautification work has been done at Vidur Kuti
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala Bijnor ground report (21 Aug 2026) quotes the chief priest of Vidur Kuti saying beautification work was done there after the government changed; the article is about Bijnor city, not Noorpur.

Survey statement (Hindi): *नूरपुर नगर पालिका का दायरा बढ़ने वाला है
Voter says (English): *The Noorpur municipal area is going to be expanded
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (29 Jul 2025) reports the DM endorsed expanding Noorpur municipal board (area 9.06 to 11.48 sq km) to include Pipla Jagir and Noorpur Dehat (Theri), and that the proposal awaits state approval. This is an announcement only, not a delivered benefit.

Survey statement (Hindi): नूरपुर शहर में दिन-रात बार-बार बिजली गुल, कारोबार पर असर
Voter says (English): In Noorpur town, power keeps going off day and night again and again, hurting business
Basis: Noorpur city (inside the AC: Noorpur MB is in the AC's Chandpur tehsil extent per Wikipedia). Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026): after storm and rain, traders in Noorpur city protested unannounced power cuts; repeated day and night outages were hurting business; the SDO said the problem would be resolved soon.

Survey statement (Hindi): धामपुर-नूरपुर सड़क पर हर बारिश में गड्ढे और पानी, घंटों जाम लगता है
Voter says (English): Every monsoon the Dhampur-Noorpur road fills with water and deep potholes, and vehicles get stuck for hours
Basis: Amar Ujala (11 Oct 2026): on the Dhampur-Noorpur road near Dheli Ahir village, the Gangan river rose and submerged the road; vehicles were stuck for hours and traffic was disrupted for three days. The report says waterlogging at this spot occurs every monsoon year. ADM Anshika Dixit ordered potholes filled. AC membership of Dheli Ahir is unconfirmed, so this is not counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): नूरपुर इलाके में गन्ने की फसल लाल सड़न और बाढ़ से खराब हुई
Voter says (English): Sugarcane crop in the Noorpur area was destroyed by red rot and river flooding
Basis: District-level area list, dated 2024: ChiniMandi (14 Mar 2024) quotes Manoj Kumar Kont, Special Secretary of the Dhampur Sugarcane Committee, that about 25-30 per cent of the cane crop in Dhampur, Seohara, Bilai, Afzalgarh and Noorpur was destroyed by red rot disease and river flooding. Noorpur is named among five areas. No later figure found.

Survey statement (Hindi): नूरपुर रोड पर जाम लगता है
Voter says (English): There is a jam on the Noorpur road
Basis: District-level, AC membership of these roads unconfirmed: Zee News Hindi (31 Dec 2024) says the planned bypass will take jams on the Chandpur road and Noorpur road out of Bijnor city. The article does not give how often the jams occur.

Survey statement (Hindi): *देहात में पेड़ की टहनी तार छूए तो बिजली गुल हो जाती है
Voter says (English): *In villages, when a tree branch touches the power line, power goes off
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026) says rural power cuts were caused by trees and branches touching the lines. The report is Bijnor district-level and does not name Noorpur AC villages.

Survey statement (Hindi): रेलवे फाटक 432-बी से सहसपुर बॉर्डर तक सड़क चौड़ी हो गई है
Voter says (English): The road has been widened from railway crossing 432-B to the Sahaspur border
Basis: Amar Ujala, dateline Kanth (18 May 2026), verified: 'नगर में रेलवे क्रॉसिंग 432-बी से सहसपुर बॉर्डर तक तो मार्ग को चौड़ा कर दिया गया' (the stretch within the town has been widened to the Sahaspur border). The same article says the widening between the crossing and Chhajlat is stalled.

Survey statement (Hindi): जमालपुर मुंडा नंगला में कच्चे रास्ते का काम शुरू हो गया है
Voter says (English): Work on the unpaved road in Jamalpur Munda Nangla has started
Basis: Amar Ujala, dateline Kanth (6 Apr 2026), verified: after villagers said they would take the problem to the CM, officials assured a road would be built and work started on a roughly 200 m kachcha road; the pond around the village was also cleaned. The article places the village in Chhajlet but names no block, so AC membership is unconfirmed; the Wikipedia extent does not list Chhajlet.

Survey statement (Hindi): खाद की उपलब्धता से मैं संतुष्ट हूं
Voter says (English): I am satisfied with the availability of fertiliser
Basis: Amar Ujala, Kanth (31 Aug 2026), verified: farmer Kuldeep Kumar 'ने खाद की उपलब्धता पर संतोष जताया'. This is one farmer's view; the same article records other farmers complaining about small-pack sales and high fertiliser prices, so it is a weak positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): *सड़क चौड़ीकरण पूरा हो तो गड्ढों से राहत मिलेगी
Voter says (English): *If the highway widening is finished, potholes may be relieved
Basis: Inference: no completed benefit on the Kanth-Chhajlat road was found. Amar Ujala (18 May 2026, verified) says the widening between the railway crossing and Chhajlat has been stopped for months, so this is a conditional hope, not a delivered benefit.

Survey statement (Hindi): *विधायक जी हमारी समस्याएं डीएम तक ले गए
Voter says (English): *The MLA took our local problems to the DM
Basis: Inference: Bhaskar (9 Apr 2026, verified) reports SP MLA Kamal Akhtar went to the DM's office over bridge repairs and the drinking water crisis. This is advocacy, not a delivered benefit, so it is flagged as inference.

Survey statement (Hindi): कांठ-छजलैट सड़क का काम रुका है, गड्ढों से रोज़ हादसे हो रहे हैं
Voter says (English): Work on the Kanth-Chhajlat road has stopped, and potholes cause accidents every day
Basis: Amar Ujala, dateline Kanth (18 May 2026), verified: 'कांठ और छजलैट के बीच इस मार्ग में काफी गड्ढे होने से हर रोज हादसे भी हो रहे हैं'; widening between the railway crossing and Chhajlat has been stopped for months; Forest Department has taken over land in Hasanagarhi and work still has not started; one-side widening from Kumar Petrol Pump crossing to Lala Masjid is also stalled. Kanth town is inside the AC (Wikipedia extent: Kanth tehsil).

Survey statement (Hindi): कांठ-अमरोहा रोड पर रेलवे फाटक के पास गड्ढों में पानी भरा है
Voter says (English): On the Kanth-Amroha road near the railway crossing, potholes are full of water
Basis: Amar Ujala, Kanth (3 Sep 2026), verified: waterlogging at several places in Kanth town; potholes on both sides of railway crossing 433-B on the Kanth-Amroha road, with e-rickshaws overturning; residents demanded the potholes be filled; SDM Kanth said a letter would be written to the department. Kanth town is inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): पाकबड़ा में साफ पीने के पानी की बहुत कमी है
Voter says (English): There is a severe shortage of clean drinking water in Pakbara
Basis: Bhaskar (9 Apr 2026), verified: 'नगर पंचायत क्षेत्र में शुद्ध पेयजल की भारी कमी है'; the MLA said land has still not been provided for the scheme. The article names the Kanth assembly constituency. Pakbara is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent ('KC Pakbara of Moradabad Teshil').

Survey statement (Hindi): रामगंगा, गगन, ढेला के रफ्ता पुल जर्जर हैं, हादसे हो चुके हैं
Voter says (English): The temporary bridges over the Ramganga, Gagan and Dhela are badly damaged, and accidents have happened
Basis: Bhaskar (9 Apr 2026), verified: several temporary bridges (रफ्ता पुल) over the Ramganga, Gagan and Dhela are 'बेहद जर्जर और खतरनाक स्थिति' and there have been accidents on them, some fatal. Specific villages are not named, so this is AC-level, not place-confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): कांठ वार्ड एक में टोंटियां लगीं, पर पानी नहीं आया
Voter says (English): In Kanth town ward one, taps are fitted but no water has come
Basis: Amar Ujala, dateline Kanth (8 Jul 2026), verified: pipes and taps fitted outside homes in the ward, but 'अभी पानी की आपूर्ति शुरू नहीं हुई है'; councillor Sonam Kaur: 'मगर अभी पानी नहीं आया'; residents still fetch water from hand pumps. Chairman Iqbal Alam (nagar panchayat) says pipeline work is pending in some areas.

Survey statement (Hindi): मुरादाबाद-ठाकुरद्वारा फोरलेन का आधा काम हो गया, दिसंबर तक पूरा होने की उम्मीद
Voter says (English): The Moradabad-Thakurdwara four-lane is half done and expected to finish by December
Basis: NHAI Project Director Arvind Kumar, as reported: about 50% of the work is done and the four-lane is expected to finish by December; 48 km project, estimated about Rs 625 crore. District-level highway project, not AC-specific. The same article reports cracks on the new sections and potholes on the old highway.

Survey statement (Hindi): सावन से पहले ठाकुरद्वारा-सुरजननगर सड़क की मरम्मत तो हुई
Voter says (English): At least the Thakurdwara-Surjannagar road got repaired before Sawan
Basis: Before Sawan, residents raised the road's condition because it is a Kanwar route, and PWD repaired it. The article says the repair lasted only a few days: potholes reappeared, and a PWD Assistant Engineer said rain had damaged the repaired road again. The repair happened; its durability did not.

Survey statement (Hindi): *सोमवार को मुआवजा मिलने की बात है, राहत मिले तो अच्छा
Voter says (English): *Compensation is said to come on Monday, a relief if it actually arrives
Basis: Inference: the article (12 Oct 2026) says affected farmers will be given compensation on Monday; the CM will distribute it online and the DM will hand it to 25 farmers at the Collectorate. It describes this as scheduled, not as already paid, so it is an announcement and not a delivered benefit. Tehsil survey: about 400 farmers affected after the Sunday storm.

Survey statement (Hindi): *ठाकुरद्वारा-सुरजननगर सड़क अब मरम्मत नहीं, फिर से बनेगी, अच्छा है
Voter says (English): *The Thakurdwara-Surjannagar road will now be rebuilt, not just repaired, which is good
Basis: Inference: the article (13 Sep 2026) quotes PWD JE Harvinder Singh saying the road will be rebuilt rather than repaired; an estimate has gone to the government and construction is expected after the rains once financial approval arrives. A plan, not completed work.

Survey statement (Hindi): *पहले गड्ढों की मरम्मत होगी, फिर सड़क बनेगी, यह ठीक है
Voter says (English): *Potholes will be repaired first and the road rebuilt afterwards, which is fine
Basis: Inference: PWD JE Anandpal Singh says all roads in the Thakurdwara assembly area are now under the World Bank section, with potholes to be repaired first and the road rebuilt afterward. This is a plan and an announcement; no completed work was found in sources.

Survey statement (Hindi): ठाकुरद्वारा-सुरजननगर सड़क पर पांच साल से गड्ढे, बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): The Thakurdwara-Surjannagar road has had potholes for five years and fills with water in rain
Basis: Amar Ujala (31 Aug 2026): road poor for about five years; rain filled the potholes; PWD repairs break up within days; a 10-metre widening announced about a year earlier is not implemented. Amar Ujala (13 Sep 2026): residents of about 100 villages are affected, problem for five years, PWD JE says the road will be rebuilt. The road starts at Thakurdwara town; Surjannagar's AC membership is not explicitly confirmed by the articles. Durations differ between articles (3 years in Jul, about 5 years in Aug and Sep).

Survey statement (Hindi): ठाकुरद्वारा-जसपुर सड़क पर गहरे गड्ढे, नाला नहीं है, 10 गांव परेशान हैं
Voter says (English): The Thakurdwara-Jaspur road has deep potholes, there is no drain, and 10 villages are troubled
Basis: Amar Ujala (17 Sep 2026): deep potholes on the road from Thakurdwara town to Jaspur, worst stretch about 2 km; about 10 villages use it, and several schools and coaching centres are on the route; no drain beside the road so rainwater collects; road built about five years ago and not maintained. Assistant Engineer Anandpal Singh names the Thakurdwara assembly area. Villages named include Mastlipur, Sanyasiwala and Karnawala Khalsa.

Survey statement (Hindi): ठाकुरद्वारा-हाईवे लिंक सड़क खस्ताहाल है, मरम्मत अभी बाकी है
Voter says (English): The Thakurdwara highway link road is dilapidated and the repair is still pending
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 Sep 2026): about 5 km link road from the Thakurdwara-Moradabad highway to Aslempur Gopiwala, described as dilapidated (खस्ताहाल); built about four years ago; heavy mining dumper traffic from Uttarakhand damaged it. Villages quoted: Nirmalpur and Madhowala. Assistant Engineer Anandpal Singh says PWD's World Bank section has a repair estimate, and that the whole Thakurdwara assembly constituency is under that section. Waterlogging is not mentioned in this article.

Survey statement (Hindi): ठाकुरद्वारा-फरीदनगर की तीन किमी सड़क बेहाल, नाले का पानी सड़क पर बहता है
Voter says (English): The three km Thakurdwara-Faridnagar road is badly broken and drain water flows over it
Basis: Amar Ujala (21 Sep 2026): about 3 km road from inside Thakurdwara town (Kashipur Chungi) to Faridnagar village; potholes in many places; in the town section, drain water keeps flowing over the road; built about 10 years ago, not maintained. PWD JE says it is now under the World Bank section. Faridnagar's AC membership is not separately confirmed, but the road starts inside the town.

Survey statement (Hindi): हमारी धान की फसल बारिश और तेज हवा से गिर गई
Voter says (English): Our paddy crop was knocked down by rain and strong wind
Basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026): storm on Sunday evening knocked down paddy and sugarcane in fields at Thakurdwara; tehsil survey found about 400 farmers affected, paddy worst hit; farmers Babblu Singh and Uday Pal said output would be hit. Tehsil-level report, Thakurdwara named as the area; not counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): *सरकारी राशन और पेंशन योजना से कुछ परिवारों को मदद मिलती है
Voter says (English): *Government ration and pension schemes help some families here
Basis: Inference: no AC-specific report of a delivered scheme benefit was found in the sources searched. The Amar Ujala Moradabad Dehat report (28 Aug 2026) does not mention ration or pension schemes.

Survey statement (Hindi): कुछ किसान कहते हैं, विधायक आते हैं, उनकी नजर में काम सही है
Voter says (English): Some farmers say the MLA visits, and in their view the work is right
Basis: Amar Ujala report on Moradabad Dehat (28 Aug 2026): some farmers said the MLA visits and that in their view the work is correct ("विधायक आते हैं और उनकी नजर में काम सही है"). No project, road or village is named, so this is a weak, opinion-level positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): *किसानों को सरकारी खरीद और समर्थन मूल्य से कुछ सहारा मिलता है
Voter says (English): *Farmers get some help from government procurement and the support price
Basis: Inference: no Moradabad Dehat-specific report on procurement benefits was found. Farmers in the seat raised fertiliser and price problems in the Amar Ujala report (28 Aug 2026), so this is not confirmed as a positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): *कुछ गांवों में नहर और नलकूप से खेत की सिंचाई हो जाती है
Voter says (English): *In some villages, fields get irrigated from the canal and tubewells
Basis: Inference: no AC-specific source confirming canal or tubewell irrigation coverage was fetched. A June 2026 Amar Ujala snippet (Thakurdwara dateline, not fetched) mentions private tubewells, but it is not a government benefit and is not confirmed for this AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): *कुछ जगहों पर हैंडपंप और टंकी से पीने का पानी मिल जाता है
Voter says (English): *In some places, drinking water is available from handpumps and tanks
Basis: Inference: no AC-specific source on water supply coverage was found. Other Moradabad reports seen in search describe water not reaching homes in city localities, so this positive is weak and unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): हमें खाद की कमी और बढ़ती महंगाई से परेशानी है
Voter says (English): We are troubled by the fertiliser shortage and rising prices
Basis: Amar Ujala report on Moradabad Dehat (28 Aug 2026): farmers named fertiliser shortage (खाद की उपलब्धता) and rising prices as their main concerns ("खाद की कमी और बढ़ती महंगाई उनके मुख्य मुद्दे हैं"). Seat-level, not a single village. Lived-experience content only.

Survey statement (Hindi): चक्कर की मिलक में हमारी सड़क जर्जर हो चुकी है, गड्ढे पड़े हैं
Voter says (English): In Chakkar ki Milak our road has become dilapidated, with potholes
Basis: Amar Ujala (13 Feb 2026): Ward 25, Chakkar ki Milak; a road built about a year earlier was dug up for sewer work and left with potholes and a broken surface. AC membership unconfirmed: the article names no vidhan sabha. Jan 2025 report: MLA Nasir Qureshi (Moradabad Dehat) raised the dilapidated road at Chakkar ki Milak in the Nagar Nigam board meeting as a problem of his assembly constituency.

Survey statement (Hindi): बालाजी मंदिर रोड पर गड्ढे हैं
Voter says (English): There are potholes on Balaji Mandir Road
Basis: Amar Ujala (9 Jan 2025): MLA Nasir Qureshi raised potholes on Balaji Mandir Road at the Nagar Nigam board meeting, described as problems of his assembly constituency. AC membership rests on the MLA's statement; no independent source found. Article is about 21 months old; current state not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): झब्बू का नाला चोक पड़ा है
Voter says (English): The Jhabbu ka Nala drain is choked
Basis: Amar Ujala (9 Jan 2025): MLA Nasir Qureshi raised the choked Jhabbu ka Nala at the Nagar Nigam board meeting, described as problems of his assembly constituency. AC membership rests on the MLA's statement; no independent source found. No later update in the sources found.

Survey statement (Hindi): नवाबपुरा चौराहे पर सालों से कूड़े का ढेर पड़ा है
Voter says (English): A garbage heap has lain at Nawabpura chauraha for years
Basis: Amar Ujala (9 Jan 2025): MLA Nasir Qureshi raised the garbage heap at Nawabpura chauraha, described as lying there for years, at the Nagar Nigam board meeting. AC membership rests on the MLA's statement; no independent source found. Current state not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): सिविल लाइंस में 100 बेड का सरकारी अस्पताल बनने लगा है
Voter says (English): A 100-bed government hospital has started being built in Civil Lines
Basis: Royal Bulletin (23 Feb 2026): bhoomi pujan and foundation stone for a 100-bed government medical care hospital in the Civil Lines area, with construction start; the article names the Nagar MLA Ritesh Gupta as performing it. No completion date. Civil Lines is listed under Moradabad Rural in the BJP mandal report (31 Dec 2024), so the locality may be split between the two seats; the Nagar MLA link supports AC 28.

Survey statement (Hindi): बुद्धि विहार का त्रिशूल रक्षा संग्रहालय खुल गया, अच्छी बात है
Voter says (English): The Trishul Defence Museum in Buddhi Vihar has opened, which is a good thing
Basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026): the Trishul Indian Defence Museum and Shri Ram Vatika in Buddhi Vihar were inaugurated in June 2026, with Bharatiya Khel Park and other projects dedicated on the same occasion. The article does not name the seat. Buddhi Vihar is named inside the Moradabad Nagar seat section of Amar Ujala's 20 Apr 2024 report (location evidence only; no electoral content used).

Survey statement (Hindi): बुद्धि विहार में संविधान-साहित्य पार्क बनकर तैयार हो गया
Voter says (English): The constitution-literature park in Buddhi Vihar is built
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Jun 2025): constitution-literature park in Buddhi Vihar built at a cost of Rs 15 crore; Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla was chief guest at the event held on Wednesday (25 Jun 2025). The article does not name the seat; Buddhi Vihar is named inside Moradabad Nagar as in item 2.

Survey statement (Hindi): भीमराव अंबेडकर पार्क और इको हर्बल पार्क बनकर तैयार हैं
Voter says (English): MDA parks like Bhimrao Ambedkar and Eco Herbal are complete
Basis: MDA project page lists Bhimrao Ambedkar Park (Ashiyana) and Eco Herbal Park (Sector 9), Moradabad, both with status Completed. Official district-level MDA page, undated, no completion dates. AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): एमडीए की जिज्ञासा लाइब्रेरी बनकर तैयार है
Voter says (English): The MDA Jigyasa library is built and ready
Basis: MDA project page lists MDA Library Jigyasa (New Moradabad) with status Completed. Official district-level MDA page, undated. AC membership unconfirmed.
Sources: Moradabad Development Authority (official project page) undated: https://mdamoradabad.up.gov.in/all-projects

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश होते ही लाइनपार में पानी भर जाता है, घर से निकलना मुश्किल
Voter says (English): Rain fills Line Par with water and makes it hard to step out
Basis: Royal Bulletin (27 Sep 2026): after about 30 hours of rain, waterlogging in Line Par, Budh Bazar and Ramganga Vihar; the article says Line Par is a persistent problem that makes it hard for residents to leave home; Nagar Nigam teams are draining with machines.
