Basis: Inference: district-level, mill not named as Malakpur. ChiniMandi (3 May 2024), citing Amar Ujala: Rs 12 crore 56 lakh 30 thousand sent to the committee's account for farmers; 97.61% of total outstanding dues cleared up to April 25

Survey statement (Hindi): * बड़ौत में बावली मार्ग पर काम शुरू हुआ, पहले नाली-पुलिया बन रही हैं
Voter says (English): * Baavli road work is under way in Baraut, drains and culverts being built first
Basis: Inference: AC-specific but only under way, not completed. Feb 2025 Amar Ujala: Executive Officer Manoj Kumar said culverts and drains are being built first and work will finish soon; no completion report found, current status unverified

Survey statement (Hindi): मलकपुर मिल ने गन्ने के बकाया का ब्याज नहीं दिया
Voter says (English): Malakpur sugar mill has not paid interest on farmers' cane dues
Basis: Aug 2025 DM review: Malakpur mill's dues were Rs 240 crore of the Rs 354 crore total (five mills named). 11 Oct 2026 mahapanchayat at Malkapur village: farmers say interest on cane dues for 1996 to 2026 has not been paid despite a High Court order (ChiniMandi citing Bhaskar). AC: Wikipedia extent lists Malakpur village under Baraut tehsil; the 2026 article spells it Malkapur, same village assumed, not stated in source

Survey statement (Hindi): मलकपुर मिल का प्रदूषित पानी छोड़ने का आरोप है, दिक्कत हो रही है
Voter says (English): Allegation: Malakpur sugar mill is letting out polluted water, causing problems in the area
Basis: ChiniMandi (6 Oct 2026, citing Bhaskar): polluted water discharged from the Malkapur sugar mill to be raised at the 11 Oct 2026 mahapanchayat; residents say 'the discharge is causing problems in the area'. Allegation; no second source checked. AC membership as for item 1

Survey statement (Hindi): बावली मार्ग दो महीने खुदा रहा, दुकानदारों का 50 प्रतिशत धंधा गिरा
Voter says (English): Baavli road in Baraut was dug up for two months, shopkeepers say business fell 50 percent
Basis: Amar Ujala (10 Feb 2025), Baraut dateline: Baavli Marg near Thakurdwara in Baraut town dug up for about two months; shopkeepers say business fell 50 percent; school students face trouble daily. Article is from Feb 2025; current status unverified

Survey statement (Hindi): सराया रोड की अवैध कॉलोनी, प्लॉट लिया पर न नक्शा पास, न लोन
Voter says (English): Plots bought in unapproved colonies on Saraya Road, Baraut cannot get maps or loans
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Mar 2025): Baghpat-Baraut-Khekra Vikas Pradhikaran sealed four illegal colonies on Saraay Road, Baraut; AE Asif Hussain said plot maps cannot be passed while the colony map is unapproved, and buyers cannot get loans. Baraut town is inside the AC (Baraut MB)

Survey statement (Hindi): सात गांव कान्हड़ ब्लॉक में भेजने का विरोध, बहुत दूर है
Voter says (English): Seven villages object to being moved to Kanhad block, which is very far
Basis: Amar Ujala (13 Sep 2025): villagers of Ashrafabad Thal, Khadana, Ibrahimpur Majra, Fatehpur, Kishanpur, Baral and Budhpur object to moving from Baraut block to Kanhad block, which they say is far. AC membership unconfirmed: these villages are not named in the Wikipedia extent list

Survey statement (Hindi): मलकपुर, बागपत और रामला मिलों ने किसानों का पूरा गन्ना बकाया दे दिया
Voter says (English): Malakpur, Baghpat and Ramala sugar mills have paid farmers' cane dues in full
Basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, re-opened): 'बागपत की तीनों चीनी मिलों ने किसानों का संपूर्ण भुगतान कर दिया है'; the article names the three as Malakpur, Baghpat and Ramala. The same article says Kinauni and Bhainsana mills still owe (see N1) and are not among the three. District-level; AC membership of the mills not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): * गन्ने का भुगतान अब समय पर मिलने लगा है
Voter says (English): * Sugarcane payments are coming on time now
Basis: Inference: the Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 Baghpat farmers' ground report appears to say payments are now timely, but the page returned 403 and could not be read, so no source is cited. District-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): * खाद के लिए अब पहले जैसी लंबी लाइन नहीं लगानी पड़ती
Voter says (English): * Fertiliser no longer means long queues like before
Basis: Inference: the Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 Baghpat ground report is reported to say this, but the page could not be opened, so no source is cited. District-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): * सिंचाई के लिए बिजली अब पहले से कुछ बेहतर मिल रही है
Voter says (English): * Power for irrigation has improved somewhat
Basis: Inference: the Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 Baghpat ground report is reported to say this, but the page could not be opened, so no source is cited. District-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): * रात में खेत पर जाने का पहले जैसा डर नहीं रहा
Voter says (English): * Farmers no longer feel the same fear of going to fields at night
Basis: Inference: the Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 Baghpat ground report is reported to say this, but the page could not be opened, so no source is cited. District-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): किनौनी मिल पर 20 करोड़, भैंसाना पर 9 करोड़ बकाया है
Voter says (English): Kinauni mill still owes ₹20 crore and Bhainsana mill ₹9 crore in cane dues
Basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026): Kinauni mill owes ₹20 crore and Bhainsana mill ₹9 crore; the district cane officer issued notices to clear dues within a week; the two mills are not showing interest in paying. District-level. AC membership of Kinauni and Bhainsana unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): खेकड़ा में 12 गांवों की जमीन का अधिग्रहण, चार गुना मुआवजा चाहिए
Voter says (English): Land acquisition for an industrial area in 12 Khekra villages, farmers want 4x compensation
Basis: Univarta (25 Aug 2026): land acquisition of 12 villages for a proposed industrial area in the Khekra area; farmers insist on four times market rate; SDM-chaired meeting ended without agreement and the demand is to be forwarded to the state government. Khekra tehsil is in the AC per Wikipedia extent. ETV Bharat (7 Jun 2026) reports the same four-times demand for a 2,000 ha UPSIDA corridor with a mahapanchayat of 12 villages; it does not name Khekra or any tehsil, and its villages (Lahchauda, Sarfabad, Garhi Kalanjari) are not confirmed inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): बागपत में 23 डॉक्टर लापता हैं, सीएचसी में इलाज की दिक्कत है
Voter says (English): 23 doctors missing in Baghpat district, Khekra and Baghpat CHCs short-staffed
Basis: Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026): '47 चिकित्सकों की कमी' and '23 चिकित्सक लापता' in the district; doctors listed missing from Khekra CHC and Baghpat CHC; 'लोगों को स्वास्थ्य सेवाएं नहीं मिल पा रहीं'. District-level, with the two named CHCs inside the AC (Khekra tehsil; Baghpat CHC in Baghpat town).

Survey statement (Hindi): बागपत बस अड्डे पर घंटों इंतजार, लोग लटककर सफर करने को मजबूर
Voter says (English): Hours-long waits at Baghpat bus stand on Raksha Bandhan, passengers forced to hang onto vehicles
Basis: Amar Ujala (29 Aug 2026): on Raksha Bandhan, buses could not be found at the Bawli Chungi bus stand in Baghpat, passengers waited for hours and were forced onto daggamar vehicles; a passenger said 'इनमें भी जगह नहीं मिल रही है'. Baghpat town (Baghpat MB) is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): 15 घंटे बिजली गई, पानी के लिए हैंडपंपों पर भीड़ लगी
Voter says (English): 15-hour power cut stopped water supply, villagers crowd handpumps
Basis: Amar Ujala (6 Sep 2026), dateline Ratol: power stopped for 15 hours in Pooranpur Nawada and Garhi Kalanjari; drinking water supply stopped, women crowded government handpumps, residents protested. Ratol and these villages are not named in the AC extent, so AC membership is unconfirmed; district-level only.

Survey statement (Hindi): हिंडन पर लोनी-राजनगर एक्सटेंशन पुल का काम शुरू हो गया
Voter says (English): Work has started on a bridge over the Hindon linking Loni with Rajnagar Extension
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Sep 2026): MLA Nandkishor Gurjar launched work on a bridge of about 182 m over the Hindon at about Rs 42 crore, linking Loni with Raj Nagar Extension. Start only, not completed. Exact bridge location inside the AC is not stated.

Survey statement (Hindi): लोनी-भोपुरा मार्ग की मरम्मत शुरू, करीब 6 करोड़ का काम
Voter says (English): Renovation of the Loni-Bhopura road has started at about Rs 6 crore
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Sep 2026): Loni-Bhopura road renovation launched after a puja at Loni Tiraha, cost about Rs 6 crore. Article gives no completion timeline. Started, not completed.

Survey statement (Hindi): डीएलएफ कॉलोनी में जिंदल मार्ग पर सीसी सड़क का काम शुरू हुआ
Voter says (English): Cement concrete road work has started on Jindal Marg in DLF Colony, Loni
Basis: Amar Ujala (4 Jul 2025): CC road work launched on Jindal Marg, DLF Colony, Loni, as part of Rs 80 lakh development works; drain of over Rs 1 crore on both sides was in its final stage. Report is from 2025, current status unknown.

Survey statement (Hindi): बंथला ढिकौली सड़क चौड़ी करने की मंजूरी मिली, टेंडर शुरू हो गया
Voter says (English): Banthla-Dhikauli road in Loni approved for widening, tender has started
Basis: Amar Ujala (11 Oct 2026): 8 km road, Rs 14.30 crore, widening from 3.75 m to 5.5 m approved; PWD executive engineer Ram Raja said the tender process has started and work will begin before Diwali. Approval and tender only; no work reported yet.

Survey statement (Hindi): टीला मोड़ से पाइपलाइन रोड तक नई सड़क बनाने का प्रस्ताव है
Voter says (English): New road from Teela Mod along Pipeline Road proposed under GDA plan to ease jams
Basis: Navbharat Live (23 Apr 2026): GDA Master Plan 2031 proposes a road from Teela Mod along Pipeline Road (phase 1 about 1,400 m, planned width 30 m, initial 15 m). Proposal only, not built. AC membership of Teela Mod unconfirmed: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026) places an Indraprastha scheme at Teela Mod in Sahibabad.

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में लोनी-गाजियाबाद मार्ग पर दो फुट से ज़्यादा पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): After rain, more than two feet of water fills the Loni-Ghaziabad road
Basis: Amar Ujala (7 Sep 2026): more than two feet of water on the Loni-Ghaziabad road after rain; two-wheelers stalled and traffic on the Delhi-Saharanpur road disrupted. Chetna Manch (7 Sep 2026) reports residents claim about 7 km of the Delhi-Saharanpur road near Loni waterlogs (a claim, not verified).

Survey statement (Hindi): लोनी में रोज़ कूड़े में आग लगती है, धुएं से भारी प्रदूषण
Voter says (English): Garbage is set on fire in Loni every day, causing heavy pollution
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (26 Mar 2025): garbage heaps in Loni set alight daily; the report calls Loni a gas chamber and cites AQI 424 on the CPCB SAMEER app. Dated 2025; no 2026 follow-up found.

Survey statement (Hindi): लोनी डिपो के पास दिल्ली-सहारनपुर सड़क का काम डेढ़ महीने से रुका
Voter says (English): Delhi-Saharanpur road work near Loni Depot has been stalled for about six weeks
Basis: Amar Ujala (24 Jul 2026): work on the half of the Delhi-Saharanpur road from Loni Depot toward Delhi halted about 1.5 months for Jal Nigam sewer laying; PWD chief engineer Ram Raja confirmed the halt. Road has been under construction for roughly a year.

Survey statement (Hindi): एक लाख की पुलिया का बिल छह लाख तक बनाने का आरोप है
Voter says (English): Allegation that culvert work in Loni was billed up to Rs 6 lakh against about Rs 1 lakh
Basis: Chetna Manch (7 Sep 2026): residents and unnamed sources allege a culvert approved at about Rs 1 lakh was billed up to Rs 6 lakh. Allegation only; not independently verified; no official clarification published yet.

Survey statement (Hindi): नाले की सफाई अधूरी है, इसलिए गलियों में पानी जमा रहता है
Voter says (English): Loni lanes stay waterlogged because drain cleaning work is incomplete
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 Jun 2026): on Loni's broken roads, resident Murari Lal blames incomplete drain-cleaning work for water collecting in the lanes; no colony names given. Delhi-Saharanpur and Loni-Ghaziabad routes named for jams.

Survey statement (Hindi): मुरादनगर में आरआरटीएस स्टेशन से दिल्ली आना-जाना आसान हुआ है
Voter says (English): Delhi-Meerut RRTS station at Muradnagar makes travel to Delhi easier
Basis: DD News (5 Mar 2024): Muradnagar is one of three stations in the 17 km Duhai-Modinagar North section, which PM Modi was set to open on 6 March. The station opening and passenger start on 7 March 2024 are from Wikipedia only (no news report of the opening was found).
Sources: DD News 2024-03-05: https://ddnews.gov.in/%E0%A4%AA%E0%A5%80%E0%A4%8F%E0%A4%AE-%E0%A4%AE%E0%A5%8B%E0%A4%A6%E0%A5%80-%E0%A4%AC%E0%A5%81%E0%A4%A7%E0%A4%B5%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B0-%E0%A4%95%E0%A5%8B-%E0%A4%95%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%87%E0%A4%82%E0%A4%97/ | Wikipedia (Murad Nagar RRTS station) 2024-03-07: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Murad_Nagar_RRTS_station

Survey statement (Hindi): वार्ड 23 में नाली का काम शुरू हुआ, पर धीमी चाल से
Voter says (English): Drain work has started in Ward 23, though it is moving slowly
Basis: Ward 23 of Muradnagar Nagar Palika, Naya Nooraganj Eidgah road: drain construction started, but less than half is built and work has been stop-start for about two months (Amar Ujala, 22 Jul 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): इदगाह बस्ती में पानी की नई टंकी बन रही है
Voter says (English): A new water tank is under construction in Idgah Basti
Basis: Residents say pipeline laying runs from Ramlila Ground at Chungi No. 3 to a water tank under construction in Idgah Basti, Muradnagar; the article describes this in a pipeline-damage report and does not report residents appreciating it.

Survey statement (Hindi): * मुरादनगर की छह सड़कों की मरम्मत की योजना है
Voter says (English): * Six Muradnagar roads are planned for renovation under a Rs 81 crore district plan
Basis: Inference: district-level Rs 81 crore PWD estimate for 34 roads plus four bridges; article says six roads in Muradnagar, none named, and one bridge proposed there. Estimate not yet approved; work starts only after approval (Amar Ujala, 26 Sep 2025). Not a completed benefit. A search for a completed Muradnagar road project in 2026 found nothing.

Survey statement (Hindi): सावन में गंगनहर घाट पर रोज़ गंगा महाआरती हुई
Voter says (English): Daily Ganga maha-aarti was held at Gangnahar ghat during Sawan
Basis: Namami Gange district team held a daily Ganga maha-aarti at Gangnahar ghat, Muradnagar, from 30 July to 12 August 2026; the aarti has run every Wednesday and Saturday since 7 June 2025 (Amar Ujala, 31 Jul 2026). A faith event, not a service.

Survey statement (Hindi): पाइपलाइन टूटी, कई दिनों से पानी नहीं, खुदाई से दिन भर जाम
Voter says (English): Pipeline broke, no water for days, and road digging keeps traffic jammed all day
Basis: Pipeline damaged for 3-4 days on Pipeline Road near Sarna Chowk, Chungi No. 3, Muradnagar; article says about 7,000-8,000 people affected; road digging keeps traffic jammed all day; EO says supply will be restored soon, no date given.

Survey statement (Hindi): भीषण गर्मी में तीन दिन बिजली बंद, महिलाएं सब-स्टेशन पहुंचीं
Voter says (English): Three days without power in scorching heat, women gathered at the substation
Basis: Power halted for three days in six colonies (Radheshyam Vihar, Shivam Vihar, Shankar Vihar, Asalatnagar, Shobhapur and others), reported as Muradnagar; women went to the Asalatnagar substation; SDO said supply would be restored once the fault was fixed, no timeline given. Asalatnagar village membership unconfirmed; counted as Muradnagar namesake. (Amar Ujala, 23 May 2025.)

Survey statement (Hindi): वार्ड 23 की नाली रुक-रुक कर बन रही है, गंदा पानी भरता है
Voter says (English): Drain in Ward 23 is being built stop-start, and dirty water collects in the lanes
Basis: Ward 23, Muradnagar NPP, Naya Nooraganj Eidgah road: work on and off for about two months, less than half built; Mahtab Pathan (UP Minority Congress secretary) says work has been completely halted for about 15 days; contractor dumped soil making road slippery; residents want the current contractor's tender cancelled (Amar Ujala, 22 Jul 2026). Waterlogging from the clogged drain is the article's account of residents' complaint.

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगनहर घाट पर हर साल बड़ी संख्या में लोग डूबते हैं
Voter says (English): Large numbers drown at the Gangnahar ghat every year
Basis: Article says, per departmental data, a large number of people drown at the Muradnagar Ganga canal ghat every year (no figure given). Rs 5 crore canal-bed raise budget is sanctioned at state level; iron chains and railings are planned; work has not started and needs a canal water shutdown and tender (Amar Ujala, 28 Sep 2026).

Survey statement (Hindi): श्मशान घाट हादसे के पीड़ित परिवारों को नौकरी-मकान नहीं मिला
Voter says (English): Families of crematorium collapse victims say they have not received a government job or house
Basis: Roof of a corridor at the Ukhlarsi Bamba Road crematorium, Muradnagar, collapsed on 3 Jan 2021 (25 dead per article). A year later families said no government job or house had been given; they held a dharna at Nagar Palika and a rotating hunger strike; they say accused were released (families' claim, not confirmed by article). Ukhlarsi village membership unconfirmed; counted as Muradnagar namesake. Report dated 3 Jan 2022. No 2024-2026 update found, so persistence after 2022 is unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): नमो भारत चलने से साहिबाबाद से दिल्ली और मेरठ जाना आसान हुआ
Voter says (English): Namo Bharat train from Sahibabad station has made travel to Delhi and Meerut easier
Basis: Wikipedia: Sahibabad RRTS station was commissioned on 20 October 2023 and opened to the public on 21 October 2023; run by NCRTC on solar power (1,100 roof panels). District-level; AC membership of the station not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): वसुंधरा फ्लाईओवर से मोहन नगर से यूपी गेट बिना रुके पहुंच जाते हैं
Voter says (English): Vasundhara flyover lets Mohan Nagar traffic reach UP Gate without stopping
Basis: ETV Bharat (7 June 2019): Rs 49 crore Vasundhara flyover opened; it provides travel from the Mohan Nagar side to UP Gate without any stoppage. 2019 source, district-level; AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): * राजेंद्र नगर में नाला बनने वाला है, बारिश का पानी निकलेगा
Voter says (English): * Drain work in Rajendra Nagar will start so rainwater can drain away
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (18 Aug 2026) says the tender for the RCC drain and road in Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 is complete and construction is to begin within 10 days. Not yet a delivered benefit; AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): * इंदिरापुरम और वसुंधरा से इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया जाना आसान होगा
Voter says (English): * Easier to reach the industrial area from Indirapuram and Vasundhara
Basis: Inference: ETV Bharat (7 June 2019) says the flyover will let Indirapuram and Vasundhara residents reach Industrial Area Site 4 without jams. This is the article's expectation, not a resident quote; 2019 source, AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): * मेट्रो और नमो भारत पास होने से ऑटो से आना-जाना आसान है
Voter says (English): * Easy to get to Metro and Namo Bharat stations by auto from here
Basis: Inference: no source found on auto access or station connectivity for this AC. The Wikipedia station page was removed as a source because it does not state this.

Survey statement (Hindi): 1700 फैक्ट्रियों का गंदा पानी साहिबाबाद के नाले से यमुना में जाता है
Voter says (English): Waste from about 1700 factories reaches the Yamuna through the Sahibabad drain
Basis: ETV Bharat (28 July 2025): waste from about 1700 factories reaches the Yamuna through the Sahibabad drain, which flows through Sahibabad Industrial Area Site-4; BOD 220 mg/l, ideal 30 mg/l per the article. District-level; Site-4 AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में राजेंद्र नगर सेक्टर-5 में पानी भरता है, सड़कें टूटी हैं
Voter says (English): Rainwater collects in Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 and roads are damaged
Basis: Amar Ujala (18 Aug 2026), dateline Sahibabad: water collects at several spots in Sector-5 during rain and waterlogging has damaged the roads; the article says about 30,000 people will directly benefit from the project. AC membership of Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): टूटी सड़क से गाड़ियां गुजरती हैं तो धूल उड़ती है
Voter says (English): Vehicles passing the broken road in Sahibabad industrial area kick up dust
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (30 Oct 2025): road broken near Indraprastha Dental College in Sahibabad industrial area; vehicles passing over it kick up dust. Short report, no resident quotes. District-level; AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): सड़क किनारे कूड़े के ढेर में आग लगती है और धुआं फैलता है
Voter says (English): Garbage piles along roads in Site IV industrial area catch fire and send smoke
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (12 Apr 2025): roadside garbage on fire in Sahibabad Site IV industrial area, smoke rising. Short report, no official or resident quotes. District-level; AC membership not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिले की 120 फैक्ट्रियों ने चिमनी पर फिल्टर नहीं लगाए, दूसरा नोटिस
Voter says (English): 120 factories in the district did not install chimney filters and got a second notice
Basis: Amar Ujala (21 Aug 2026), dateline Sahibabad: UPPCB issued a second notice to 120 industrial units in Ghaziabad district to install chimney filters, deadline 30 September 2026. District-level, not AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): विजय नगर से बागू तक गांमी पुल की नींव रख दी गई
Voter says (English): The foundation has been laid for the Gamni bridge from Vijay Nagar to Bagu
Basis: Star Express News (22 Sep 2026): MP Atul Garg and city MLA Sanjeev Sharma laid the foundation for a bridge of about Rs 13 crore over the Delhi-Meerut Expressway, linking Vijay Nagar with Krishna Nagar-Bagu; ceremony at Vijay Nagar Bypass; completion targeted in about one year. Foundation only, not built. AC membership inferred from the Vijay Nagar location (see notes).

Survey statement (Hindi): विजय नगर में सड़क और पार्क के 1.26 करोड़ के काम शुरू हुए
Voter says (English): Road and park works worth about Rs 1.26 crore have started in Vijay Nagar
Basis: Udaybhoomi (14 Jul 2026): Mayor Sunita Dayal and MLA Sanjeev Sharma laid foundation stones for four works costing about Rs 1.26 crore in Vijay Nagar: a green belt boundary wall in Ward 14 (Sarvodaya Nagar) and Ward 15, Shastri Park development (no ward given), and road construction in Ward 35 (Akbarpur Beharampur). Launched, not completed. Ward 15 and 35 are on the AC ward list; Ward 14 is not.

Survey statement (Hindi): हिंडन एलिवेटेड रोड बन गई, राजनगर एक्सटेंशन से यूपी गेट तक चलती है
Voter says (English): The Hindon Elevated Road has been built and runs from Rajnagar Extension to UP Gate
Basis: Wikipedia: 10.3 km grade-separated road from Raj Nagar Extension (city) to UP Gate at the Delhi border, in operation since March 2018. Older than 2024-2026 but a delivered benefit. AC membership of the stretch is unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में सीसी रोड का काम शुरू हुआ है
Voter says (English): CC road work has started at the district hospital
Basis: Upabtak (16 Jul 2025): MLA Sanjeev Sharma inaugurated CC road work at the District Hospital (MMG), from the TB department to the mortuary; the MLA's media adviser said it would be completed soon. Started, not completed. The article does not state the hospital's AC; AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): विधायक ने शौचालयों की सफाई के लिए नगर निगम को चिट्ठी लिखी
Voter says (English): The MLA has written a letter to the corporation about cleaning the toilets
Basis: Weak positive, a demand with no action: Jan Sagar Today (29 Aug 2026): MLA Sanjeev Sharma wrote to the Municipal Commissioner seeking regular, scheduled cleaning and repair of more than 50 public toilets in the Shahar assembly constituency. The article says attention is now on the corporation's response; no corporation action is reported.

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में अंडरपास और सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है, जाम लगता है
Voter says (English): When it rains, underpasses and roads fill with water and jams build up
Basis: Amar Ujala (6 Sep 2026, rain on 5 Sep): the NH-9 underpass in Vijaynagar Industrial Area was closed by water; about one foot of water in Karpuri Puram; water in Govindpuram and Vijayanagar sectors 3 and 9; main road jammed for about half an hour. TNP News (17 Sep 2026, Ghaziabad Sadar seat): waterlogging, poor drainage and traffic jams listed as major election issues. Only the Vijaynagar underpass is named as inside Vijay Nagar; Karpuri Puram and Govindpuram AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): विजय नगर सेक्टर 12 में सड़कों पर गड्ढे हैं, नालियां साफ नहीं होतीं
Voter says (English): In Vijay Nagar Sector 12 roads have potholes and the drains are not cleaned
Basis: Amar Ujala (19 Aug 2026), Vijayanagar Sector 12 C Block (about 7,000 residents): resident Shekhar said there are big potholes and accidents and complaints go unheeded; Rahul Singh said drains not being cleaned cause major problems in the rainy season. Ward councillor Omveer Singh Odh said repair work is ongoing and the remaining issues will be fixed soon. No ward number is given for Sector 12.

Survey statement (Hindi): विजयनगर निकासी पर रोज जान जोखिम में डालकर सड़क पार करनी पड़ती है
Voter says (English): Every day we have to cross the road at the Vijaynagar exit, risking our lives
Basis: Udaybhoomi (4 Sep 2025): residents say they must cross the expressway daily at risk to their lives; the article says a traffic policeman died in an accident near the Vijaynagar exit earlier. Gadkari has directed officials to begin an overbridge process; this is a direction, not a built overbridge.

Survey statement (Hindi): विजय नगर का पुल पांच साल में भी तैयार नहीं हुआ
Voter says (English): The Vijay Nagar bridge is still not ready even after five years
Basis: Amar Ujala city-seat issues section (2022 election page; the text is undated): the bridge connecting Vijay Nagar and the city is not ready even after five years. No 2026 report found confirming the bridge's status, so treat as possibly stale.

Survey statement (Hindi): सेक्टर 12 में पीने के पानी और बिजली कटौती की दिक्कत रहती है
Voter says (English): In Sector 12, drinking water and power cuts are a constant problem
Basis: Amar Ujala (19 Aug 2026): resident Rajeev said drinking water and power cuts have been persistent problems and complaints get no response. Single resident's statement.

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर नॉर्थ तक रैपिड रेल चलने से सफर आसान हुआ
Voter says (English): The rapid rail now reaches Modinagar North and the trip has become easier
Basis: Amar Ujala (7 Mar 2024, verified): PM virtually inaugurated the 17 km Duhai to Modinagar North section; regular passenger service was to start 8 March at 6 AM; NCRTC officials give 24 minutes from Sahibabad to Modinagar North. Wikipedia station page (verified): station is in Modinagar town, Ghaziabad district, inaugurated 6 March 2024

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर से सराय काले खां तक रैपिड रेल से जा सकते हैं
Voter says (English): From Modinagar you can now take rapid rail to Sarai Kale Khan
Basis: Amar Ujala (20 Feb 2026, verified): the Delhi-Meerut Namo Bharat line now extends from Sarai Kale Khan to Begumpul. The article does not mention Modinagar; the link to Modinagar North comes from the Wikipedia station page (verified), whose infobox shows Platform 2 toward Sarai Kale Khan. Line-level fact, not a Modinagar-only change

Survey statement (Hindi): *मोदीनगर की कई गलियों में स्ट्रीट लाइट लगी है
Voter says (English): *Many lanes in Modinagar have street lights
Basis: Inference: SquareYards locality page (undated, verified) says the locality is well-lit with street lamps in multiple areas. Listing-site summary, not a news report or official source

Survey statement (Hindi): *मोदीनगर के कई इलाकों में सड़कें अच्छी बनी हैं
Voter says (English): *Roads in many parts of Modinagar are well built
Basis: Inference: SquareYards page (undated, verified) lists 'Well Built Roads with Sidewalk' as a positive from reviews, but its overview also says residents dislike the poor road conditions, so this is contested

Survey statement (Hindi): *मोदीनगर स्टेशन पर गाड़ी पार्क करने की सुविधा है
Voter says (English): *Modinagar station has a parking facility for cars
Basis: Inference: Wikipedia station page (verified) infobox lists Accessible: Yes and Four-Wheeler Parking. A facility fact, not a voter-voiced benefit

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर-कलछीना सड़क सिर्फ 3.75 मीटर चौड़ी है, जगह-जगह टूटी है
Voter says (English): The Modinagar-Kalchhina road is only 3.75 metres wide and broken in many places
Basis: Amar Ujala (3 Aug 2026, verified): road is 3.75 m wide, damaged in many places, aggregate has come loose; 14.5 km road serves more than 50,000 people in villages along it. Widening (to 5.5 m, about Rs 35 crore) is proposed, not approved. AC membership unconfirmed: the Modinagar end is inside the AC, but Kalchhina village is not confirmed inside it (one postal listing says Hapur tehsil), so not counted in ac_specific_negatives

Survey statement (Hindi): *बारिश में मोदीनगर की गलियों में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): *In the rainy season water fills up the lanes of Modinagar
Basis: Inference: SquareYards page (verified) quotes reviewers saying the area sees heavy waterlogging in peak rainy seasons and lacks proper drainage. Reviews are undated except Nov 2022 and are not a news report. No 2024-26 Modinagar news on waterlogging was found (a ghaziabad365 Modinagar drain-repair item returned 404 and is not used)

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर में बच्चा उठाने की कोशिश हुई, पुलिस ने रिपोर्ट नहीं लिखी
Voter says (English): An attempt was made to take a child away in Modinagar, and police did not file a report
Basis: Amar Ujala video (16 Sep 2026, verified): the headline says abduction but the body describes an attempt; a neighbour followed and the suspects fled leaving the child; CCTV footage has surfaced; police had not registered an FIR two days after the incident. Lane is in Modinagar town (inside the AC)

Survey statement (Hindi): ड्यूटी से लौटते एक युवक को मोदीनगर में सड़क पर रोककर पीटा गया
Voter says (English): A youth returning from duty was stopped on a Modinagar road and beaten up
Basis: Amar Ujala video (15 Feb 2026, verified): headline 'Modinagar mein duty se laut rahe yuvak ki pitai'; a youth returning from duty was stopped on the road by some people and beaten severely. Attackers, cause and injuries not stated; no arrest or follow-up named. Modinagar town is inside the AC (Wikipedia AC extent: KC Modinagar, Modinagar MB)

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर तहसील में कूड़ा है, दीवारों पर पान के दाग हैं
Voter says (English): Garbage is piled up at the Modinagar tehsil office, with pan stains on the walls
Basis: Amar Ujala impact story (6 Oct 2026, verified): the Modinagar tehsil premises were covered in garbage, walls stained with pan spit, empty beer cans found; cleanup work at the tehsil has since started after the report, so this may be fixed. Tehsil office is in Modinagar town (inside the AC)

Survey statement (Hindi): *पिलखुवा के चार वार्डों में सड़क-नाली के लिए टेंडर निकल गए हैं
Voter says (English): *Tenders have been issued for roads and drains in four Pilkhuwa wards
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (24 Aug 2026, opened) says Rs 2.25 crore for about 2.5 km of roads and drains in Pilkhuwa wards 2, 3, 5 and 6; tenders issued, work planned to start end-September. No later source confirms the start. Pilkhuwa MB is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): *धौलाना की 18 सड़कों की मरम्मत का प्रस्ताव भेजा गया है
Voter says (English): *A proposal to repair 18 roads in Dhaulana has been sent
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (22 Sep 2026, opened) says PWD sent MLA Dharmesh Tomar's proposal for special repair of 18 roads in the Dhaulana area, about Rs 6 crore; work starts only after state approval. Proposal only, not delivered. Named routes: Dasna-Dhaulana-Gulaothi road and the Badnauli route; Dhaulana KC and Dasna NP are inside the AC extent per Wikipedia.

Survey statement (Hindi): *बारिश में पालिका की टीम पानी भरे इलाकों में भेजी गई
Voter says (English): *During rain, a municipal team was sent to waterlogged areas
Basis: Inference: Executive Officer Indrapal Singh is quoted in Amar Ujala (28 Jul 2026, opened) saying the municipal team was sent immediately to waterlogged areas during rain and drainage work is underway. An official claim only, not verified on the ground; not counted as a delivered benefit.

Survey statement (Hindi): *हापुड़ चुंगी पर फ्लाईओवर 1200 मीटर तक बढ़ाने की योजना है
Voter says (English): *There is a plan to extend the Hapur Chungi flyover to 1200 metres
Basis: Inference: Daily Jagran (28 Aug 2025, archived page, opened) says the flyover will be extended to 1200 m from the initial 800 m, funded by PWD, a plan only. The article names Ghaziabad localities (Raj Nagar, Shastri Nagar, Sanjay Nagar, Kavi Nagar) and not Dhaulana. Hapur Chungi is not named in the Wikipedia extent; AC membership unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *पिलखुवा में नाले पूरे बने तो बारिश का पानी सड़क पर नहीं रुकेगा
Voter says (English): *If the Pilkhuwa drains are fully built rainwater will not stay on the roads
Basis: Inference: no sourced completion date or outcome. Drawn from the Amar Ujala (28 Jul 2026) report that waterlogging was caused by drains not being cleaned on time and inadequate drainage arrangements.

Survey statement (Hindi): पिलखुवा की रेलवे रोड, गांधी रोड पर बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): In Pilkhuwa, water fills Railway Road and Gandhi Road when it rains
Basis: Amar Ujala (28 Jul 2026, opened): waterlogging in several Pilkhuwa neighbourhoods and roads including Railway Road, Gandhi Road, Gandhi Bazaar and Jawahar Bazaar; the article attributes it to drains not cleaned on time and inadequate drainage. Residents are not quoted directly. Pilkhuwa MB is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): परतापुर रोड का अंडरपास अधूरा, इसाद नगर-सद्दीकपुरा में पानी और गंदगी
Voter says (English): The Partapur Road underpass is unfinished, and there is water and filth in Isad Nagar-Saddikpura
Basis: Pratahkal (12 Oct 2026, opened): the Partapur Road underpass in Pilkhuwa is under construction and has stalled, causing waterlogging and filth for thousands in Isad Nagar and Saddikpura; AAP threatens a sit-in at the municipal premises. Pilkhuwa MB is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): गन्ने का पिछले सत्र का पूरा बकाया न मिलने से किसान नाराज हैं
Voter says (English): Farmers are angry that the previous season's full sugarcane dues have not been paid
Basis: District-level: Amar Ujala (6 Oct 2026, opened) reports a Sambhawali sugarcane committee meeting where farmer organisations demanded full previous-season dues, cash or 14-day payment for the next season, and threatened a lockout of the sugar mill. The mill is not named and no dues figure is given; AC membership of the location is not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): धौलाना की कई सड़कों की विशेष मरम्मत की जरूरत है
Voter says (English): Many Dhaulana roads need special repair
Basis: Amar Ujala (22 Sep 2026, opened): PWD proposal for special repair of 18 roads in the Dhaulana area (about Rs 6 crore), including the Dasna-Dhaulana-Gulaothi road and the Badnauli route. The article gives no condition details beyond the need for special repair. Dhaulana KC and Dasna NP are inside the AC extent per Wikipedia.

Survey statement (Hindi): परतापुर में फैक्ट्रियों के धुएं की शिकायत है
Voter says (English): There are complaints about factory smoke in Partapur
Basis: Amar Ujala (18 Apr 2026, opened): a complaint about smoke was received; five people were booked; three units (Moon Processors, Shri Rama Industries, Shri Balaji Processors) were found burning plastic waste in boilers and their boilers and plants were sealed. The article does not quote villagers. It places Partapur in the Kotwali area, Pilkhuwa. Partapur's AC membership is unconfirmed, so this is not counted as AC-specific. District-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): मोदीनगर रोड का नया ट्रांसफार्मर लगा, सुबह बिजली लौट आई
Voter says (English): Modinagar Road area got a new transformer and power came back by morning
Basis: Amar Ujala reports that after a night-long power problem in localities linked to the Modinagar Road power station, a new transformer was installed overnight and power was restored on Wednesday morning (8 Jul 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में डायलिसिस शुरू हुई, अब मरीजों को मेरठ-दिल्ली नहीं जाना पड़ता
Voter says (English): Dialysis unit opened at district hospital, kidney patients no longer need Meerut or Delhi
Basis: Pratahkal and Khabarwala24 (both 28 Sep 2026) report a new dialysis unit at the Hapur district hospital on Modinagar Road, Hapur city (Hapur MB, inside the AC), inaugurated by the Hapur Sadar MLA. Patients earlier had to travel to Meerut, Delhi or Ghaziabad for regular dialysis; the unit now treats them locally

Survey statement (Hindi): जिला अस्पताल में गंभीर मरीजों के लिए अलग पूरा वार्ड है
Voter says (English): District hospital has a separate full ward for serious patients
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 May 2026) quotes a CHC doctor: "जिला अस्पताल में अलग से पूरा वार्ड है" - the district hospital has a separate complete ward, and serious cases are sent there from the CHC (10 emergency beds in the CHC emergency area). Khabarwala24 places the district hospital on Modinagar Road in Hapur city, inside Hapur MB

Survey statement (Hindi): डासना से हापुड़ तक छह लेन सड़क खुली, सफर आसान हुआ
Voter says (English): The six-lane road from Dasna to Hapur has opened, and the trip has become easier
Basis: Patrika (30 Sep 2019) reports Nitin Gadkari inaugurated the 22.30 km six-lane Dasna to Hapur national highway with two-lane service roads on each side, and that travel towards Moradabad and Meerut via Hapur became easier. District-level and old; the article does not say whether it passes Hapur city

Survey statement (Hindi): *हापुड़ ब्लॉक की सड़कों की मरम्मत के टेंडर निकले हैं
Voter says (English): *Road repair tenders have been issued for the Hapur block
Basis: Inference, not an appreciated delivered benefit: Amar Ujala (9 Oct 2026) reports PWD tenders totalling Rs 75 lakh for five district road repairs (about Rs 15 lakh each; Hapur among the places named). The article names no road or village in the AC, does not say work has started, and no completed local work was found. Kept only as a flagged placeholder for field check

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में स्वर्ग आश्रम रोड और दोयमी फाटक पर पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): When it rains, water fills Swarg Ashram Road and Doyami Phatak
Basis: DM Kavita Meena inspected waterlogging on LN Public School Road and Swarg Ashram Road, which daily troubles thousands of schoolchildren; she reprimanded municipal officials (28 Sep 2026). At Doyami Phatak on Swarg Ashram Road the drain work is incomplete and rainwater stands on the road (29 Sep 2026). Doyami is a polling circle listed in the AC extent

Survey statement (Hindi): मंडी मोहल्ले में 36 घंटे पानी बंद रहा, एक टैंकर काफी नहीं था
Voter says (English): Mandi mohalla had no water for 36 hours, and one tanker was not enough
Basis: Mohalla Mandi, Hapur Nagar Palika area, was without drinking water for about 36 hours; residents allege the Nagar Palika did not act seriously despite complaints, and say one tanker was insufficient for hundreds of houses. No Nagar Palika statement in the article (24 May 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): अतरपुरा बिजलीघर ढाई घंटे बंद, आठ हजार से ज्यादा घरों की बिजली गई
Voter says (English): Atarpura power station was shut for 2.5 hours and more than 8,000 homes lost power
Basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026): Atarpura power station, fed from the 220 kV Anand Vihar station, was shut for about 2.5 hours on Wednesday, cutting supply to more than 8,000 homes. The district lacks fault locator machines so linemen patrol lines by hand. Atarpura localities (Swarg Ashram Road, Gol Market, Sarraf Bazar, Chandi Road) are Hapur city areas

Survey statement (Hindi): चहकमाल में मंजूर ट्रांसफार्मर अब तक नहीं लगा, पानी भी कम
Voter says (English): The sanctioned 250 KVA transformer for Chahkamal has still not been installed, and water is also short
Basis: Residents of Mohalla Chahkamal in Hapur town say a sanctioned 250 KVA transformer has not been installed and drinking water is short; they gave a memorandum to the DM, who promised action within seven days. The article does not say whether this was done (5 Oct 2026)

Survey statement (Hindi): ओम विहार की टूटी सड़क पर गंदा पानी रहता है, शिकायतें अनसुनी
Voter says (English): The broken road in Om Vihar has dirty water standing on it, and complaints go unheard
Basis: Residents of Om Vihar Colony on Station Asaura Road, Hapur, say the about 100 m main road is broken and dirty drain water always stands on it; they complained several times and gave a memorandum to the DM with no action taken (26 Sep 2026). Asaura is listed in the AC extent (Hapur KC group, Wikipedia), but the colony's exact location is not confirmed beyond Hapur, so it is counted conservatively as not AC-specific. The Royal Bulletin URL carries a draft-style slug and the byline date (26 Sep 2026) conflicts with some related-story dates on the page

Survey statement (Hindi): *टूटी सड़कों की मरम्मत के टेंडर निकल गए हैं
Voter says (English): *Tenders have been issued to repair the broken roads
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (5 May 2025) reports Hapur-Pilkhuwa Development Authority tenders for repair of the Jawaharganj Mandi road in Garhmukteshwar (Rs 55.56 lakh) and two Brajghat roads (Rs 95.07 lakh and Rs 64.62 lakh); work was planned to start in June. The article does not say Brajghat is in the town. No start or completion is confirmed, and the source is from 2025.

Survey statement (Hindi): *गंगा मेले में हर घाट पर पुलिस चौकी बनी, सुरक्षा का इंतजाम हुआ
Voter says (English): *Police posts were set up at every ghat at the Ganga fair for security
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (2 Nov 2025) reports police stations and chowkis in every sector and at every ghat, dog squads, metal detectors, and strict security around the women's ghats at the Garhmukteshwar Ganga fair. The article does not say watch towers are at the women's ghats. It has no devotee feedback, so how people felt about it is not sourced.

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगा एक्सप्रेसवे चालू हो गया, गढ़मुक्तेश्वर का इंटरचेंज भी है
Voter says (English): The Ganga Expressway has opened and there is also a Garhmukteshwar interchange
Basis: District-level: Wikipedia says the Ganga Expressway was inaugurated on 29 April 2026 and lists a Phase 1 diamond interchange at NH-24 (Hapur-Garhmukteshwar). The page does not say how the interchange affects travel in Garhmukteshwar, so the local benefit is not stated by the source.

Survey statement (Hindi): *गांवों तक के रास्ते सुधरें तो खेत और मंडी तक पहुंच आसान हो
Voter says (English): *If village roads are improved, reaching fields and mandis would be easier
Basis: Inference: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026) reports BKU demanding repair of dilapidated village roads in Garhmukteshwar tehsil. No source found that these roads have been repaired, so improvement is a hope, not a delivered benefit.

Survey statement (Hindi): *पुलिस चौकियों और गश्त से लोगों को सुरक्षा का भरोसा मिले
Voter says (English): *Police patrols and posts give people a sense of safety
Basis: Inference: the Ganga Fair police arrangements are sourced (positive 2). No source records public feeling of safety in the AC, so this is a guess.

Survey statement (Hindi): मिलों पर गन्ने का पैसा अटका, किसान कर्ज़ में दबे हैं
Voter says (English): Sugarcane money is stuck with the mills, and farmers are under debt
Basis: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026): BKU tractor march and dharna at Garhmukteshwar tehsil, demanding payment of cane dues with interest and a higher cane price for the new season. Source says: 'समय पर पैसा न मिलने से किसान कर्ज के बोझ तले दब रहा है'. No amount owed, mill name or payment schedule is stated. The protest was at tehsil premises; Wikipedia's Garhmukteshwar page says the tehsil headquarters is in the town (AC namesake), so it is counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): आवारा गोवंश और बंदर फसल चौपट कर रहे हैं
Voter says (English): Stray cattle and monkeys are destroying crops
Basis: Khabarwala (8 Oct 2026): same BKU protest at Garhmukteshwar tehsil demanded relief from stray cattle and monkeys damaging standing crops. No count of animals or area is stated. Tehsil-wide demand; AC membership of the specific place is not confirmed, so not counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगा का पानी बढ़ा, गढ़मुक्तेश्वर के कई इलाकों में बाढ़ जैसे हालात
Voter says (English): Ganga water has risen and parts of Garhmukteshwar are in flood-like conditions
Basis: Asianet Newsable (23 Aug 2026, 12:03 PM IST) states: 'The rising water level of the Ganga has triggered a flood-like situation in parts of Garhmukteshwar, Hapur, Uttar Pradesh.' No villages, ghats, roads or figures are named. Named place is the AC namesake town.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजली विभाग जांच के नाम पर किसानों को परेशान करने का आरोप है
Voter says (English): Farmers allege the power department harasses them in the name of checks
Basis: Allegation only, as put in the BKU memorandum (Khabarwala, 8 Oct 2026): the power department harasses farmers in rural areas under the cover of checking. The source does not use the words 'power theft'. Tehsil-wide; AC membership unconfirmed; no village or case named. Not counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): कांवड़ मेला क्षेत्र में गंदगी और अव्यवस्था दिखी
Voter says (English): Dirt and disorder seen in the Kanwar fair area
Basis: Amar Ujala video page (29 Jul 2026): Divisional Commissioner inspected the Kanwar mela area at Brijghat, Garhmukteshwar, said 'यह क्या तैयारी है, हम यहां ये अव्यवस्था देखने के लिए आए हैं', and found dirt and disorder at several places (no spots named). The article text is cut off. Brijghat is placed inside the AC by Bharatpedia (aggregator): 'Nagar Palika Parishad Garhmukteshwar (City + Brijghat)'.

Survey statement (Hindi): सेक्टर-51 और 52 के बीच मेट्रो स्काईवॉक खुल गया, आना-जाना आसान
Voter says (English): Metro skywalk between Sector 51 and 52 is open now, easier to reach the station
Basis: Rs 36.90 crore skywalk linking the Sector-52 Blue Line and Sector-51 Aqua Line metro stations; trial opening in August 2026, formal inauguration reported 4 Oct 2026 (Amar Ujala). Sector 51-52 is in Noida city, which the AC Wikipedia extent covers ('It consists of the city of Noida').

Survey statement (Hindi): छजारसी और बरौला में सीवर का शिलान्यास हो गया
Voter says (English): Foundation stone for sewer work in Chhajarsi and Baraula has been laid
Basis: Foundation stones laid 14 May 2026 (Do Took Media): Rs 165.13 lakh sewer maintenance work in Chhajarsi with a 1,280 m sewer line in three lanes; Rs 978.68 lakh for a 10 MLD sewage sump well in Baraula. The article gives no completion date. Chhajarsi and Baraula are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.
Sources: Do Took Media 2026-05-14: https://www.dotookmedia.com/2026/05/blog-post_14.html | Wikipedia (Noida Assembly constituency) 2026-10-14: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noida_Assembly_constituency

Survey statement (Hindi): छजारसी और चोटपुर में 4.23 करोड़ की सड़क-नाली का काम शुरू हुआ
Voter says (English): Road and drain work worth Rs 4.23 crore has started in Chhajarsi and Chotpur
Basis: About Rs 4.23 crore for 16 road and drain projects in Chhajarsi, Chotpur, Bahlolpur and Garhi Chaukhandi, funded from MLA fund, Accelerated Economic Development Scheme and Rajya Sabha MP fund. The article says foundation stones were laid and projects inaugurated, without saying which ones; completion status unconfirmed. Chhajarsi and Chotpur are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): सोरखा में 9.82 करोड़ का तालाब बन रहा है, आधा काम हो गया
Voter says (English): A Rs 9.82 crore pond is being built in Sorkha, half the work is done
Basis: Pushkaneer pond in village Sorkha Jahidabad, cost about Rs 9.82 crore, about 50% of work complete, expected to finish in about four months; aim is water conservation and groundwater recharge (UP Ki Baat, page dated 11 Aug 2026). Sorkha Jahidabad is named in the AC Wikipedia extent.
Sources: UP Ki Baat 2026-08-11: https://www.upkibaat.com/pushkaneer-pond-being-constructed-in-noidas-sorkha-jahidabad-at-a-cost-of-%E2%82%B99-82-crore-50-of-the-work-is-complete/ | Wikipedia (Noida Assembly constituency) 2026-10-14: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noida_Assembly_constituency

Survey statement (Hindi): सेक्टर-15 के नया बांस गांव में पंचायत घर बनकर तैयार हो गया
Voter says (English): The panchayat ghar in Naya Bans village, Sector 15, is built and ready
Basis: New panchayat ghar in Naya Bans village, Sector 15, Noida, inaugurated on a Saturday reported 12 Sep 2026 (Chetna Manch). The article gives two costs, about Rs 230.86 lakh and about Rs 328.78 lakh for the building, and does not reconcile them. Sector 15 is in Noida city (AC extent: 'It consists of the city of Noida'); Naya Bans is not named in the Wikipedia list.

Survey statement (Hindi): सोरखा में 20 साल से सीवर लाइन शुरू नहीं, बारिश में सड़कें डूबतीं
Voter says (English): Sorkha's sewer line has not started in 20 years, and roads flood in rain
Basis: Sorkha village, Sector-115 Noida (Amar Ujala, 30 Apr 2026): without a sewer line, light rain floods main roads; Bharatiya Kisan Union Kranti state president warned of agitation and called the authority's chaupal a formality. Amar Ujala video (3 Jan 2025): villagers say a sewer line laid about 20 years ago has still not started, and the main road is too damaged for sanitation tankers. The two sources describe the sewer situation differently (no line vs. laid but not started); the statement follows the video. Sorkha Jahidabad is named in the AC Wikipedia extent.
Sources: Amar Ujala 2026-04-30: https://www.amarujala.com/delhi-ncr/noida/dfg-grnoida-news-c-1-noi1095-4227800-2026-04-30 | Amar Ujala 2025-01-03: https://www.amarujala.com/video/delhi-ncr/noida/video-people-of-sorkha-village-have-been-waiting-for-the-sewer-line-to-start-for-20-years | Wikipedia (Noida Assembly constituency) 2026-10-14: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noida_Assembly_constituency

Survey statement (Hindi): छजारसी-चोटपुर के डूब क्षेत्र में सैकड़ों कनेक्शन काट दिए, 24 घंटे बिजली चाहिए
Voter says (English): In the Chhajarsi-Chotpur floodplain, hundreds of power connections were cut, we want 24-hour power
Basis: ETV Bharat (1 Sep 2026): residents of the Chijarsi, Chotpur and Behlolpur floodplain say hundreds of connections were cut over the past four days; they demand 24-hour power and permanent meters. The electricity department gave no statement in the article. Chhajarsi and Chotpur are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): सेक्टर-43 में पानी बार-बार बंद, बारिश में सीवर जाम हो जाते हैं
Voter says (English): Sector 43 water supply keeps stopping, sewer blockages during monsoon
Basis: ThePrint ground report (28 Dec 2025): frequent water supply disruptions left entire blocks dry for hours; sewage blockages spread during the monsoon; streetlights stayed broken until a complaint was made. The article does not name the assembly seat; Sector 43 is in Noida city, covered by the AC extent ('It consists of the city of Noida').

Survey statement (Hindi): वीआईपी दौरे पर महामाया फ्लाईओवर से सेक्टर-51 तक घंटों जाम लगा
Voter says (English): During a VIP visit, the jam from Mahamaya flyover to Sector 51 lasted for hours
Basis: Amar Ujala (24 Sep 2026): VIP movement in the city caused jams from Mahamaya Flyover to Sector 51, also Dalit Prerna Sthal, Chilla Border and Sector 37 to 51; peak jams 7-10 am and 4-9 pm. One dated event; 'whenever VIPs pass' is not established. TNP News (16 Sep 2026) is an election-framed piece on the 2027 polls; used only for its statement that traffic and parking have long been a local issue in the Noida seat. Noida city is covered by the AC extent.
Sources: Amar Ujala 2026-09-24: https://www.amarujala.com/delhi-ncr/noida/traffic-jam-grnoida-news-c-1-noi1095-4760916-2026-09-24 | TNP News 2026-09-16: https://tnpnews.in/uttar-pradesh-election/noida-assembly-elections-2027-the-electoral-contest-between-the-sheen-of-development-and-civic-challenges-17951 | Wikipedia (Noida Assembly constituency) 2026-10-14: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noida_Assembly_constituency

Survey statement (Hindi): सेक्टर-31 में नाले खुले पड़े हैं और पानी भरता है
Voter says (English): Drains in Sector 31 are open and water collects
Basis: Review meeting at Sector-27 club (Do Took Media, 1 Apr 2026): officials were directed to cover drains in Sector 31, clear waterlogging and clean the UGR in C-Block of Sector-31. The article does not name the assembly seat; Sector 31 is in Noida city, covered by the AC extent.
Sources: Do Took Media 2026-04-01: https://www.dotookmedia.com/2026/04/blog-post_521.html | Wikipedia (Noida Assembly constituency) 2026-10-14: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noida_Assembly_constituency

Survey statement (Hindi): दादरी से ग्रेटर नोएडा ओवरब्रिज बन गया, ऐसा कहा गया है
Voter says (English): The Dadri to Greater Noida overbridge is built, so it has been announced
Basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026, updated same day): article lists a Dadri to Greater Noida overbridge among completed works, as stated by the local MLA at a press meeting; not independently verified. Completion date and cost not given. The article is Dadri-centred and does not name the vidhan sabha; Dadri town is inside AC 62 per the Wikipedia Dadri page extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): दादरी-बुलंदशहर सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, काम तेजी से चल रहा है
Voter says (English): The Dadri-Bulandshahr road is being widened and work is moving fast
Basis: ETV Bharat (19 Sep 2026, published 11:25 AM IST): widening of the road from Dadri via Chitehra to Bulandshahr and Sikandarabad is 'going fast' (तेजी से चल रहा है), with a median divider, two lanes each side and drains being built. Cost not stated. Under construction, not completed.

Survey statement (Hindi): देवला में सीसी रोड का काम शुरू, हमारी लंबे समय से मांग थी
Voter says (English): CC road work has started in Devla, a demand we had for a long time
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Jun 2026, 7:55 PM IST): about 238 m CC road at Devla village, from the Dadri-Noida road to Aryavrat School, Rs 27 lakh; article says villagers had long demanded it. Work has just started, not completed. Article names Dadri as the assembly constituency.

Survey statement (Hindi): रूपवास बाईपास बनकर जीटी रोड से जुड़ गया, ऐसा कहा गया है
Voter says (English): The Rupwas bypass is built and joined to GT Road, so it has been announced
Basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026): article says the Rupwas bypass was built to link with GT Road (जीटी रोड को जोड़ने के लिए रूपवास बाईपास का निर्माण कराया गया है), as stated by the local MLA; not independently verified. Cost and completion date not given.

Survey statement (Hindi): रेलवे रोड से नहर बाईपास, गाजियाबाद जाने में राहत मिली, ऐसा कहा गया
Voter says (English): Railway Road to canal bypass has eased travel to Ghaziabad, so it has been announced
Basis: Amar Ujala (18 Sep 2026): article says the bypass from Railway Road to the canal has given relief to people travelling towards Ghaziabad (रेलवे रोड से नहर बाईपास बनने से गाजियाबाद की ओर आने-जाने वाले लोगों को राहत मिली है), as stated by the local MLA; not independently verified. Article is Dadri-centred; Railway Road is taken to be in Dadri town (inside AC 62 per Wikipedia extent).

Survey statement (Hindi): ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में पूरा सरकारी अस्पताल नहीं, बस बिसरख सीएचसी का सहारा
Voter says (English): Greater Noida West has no full government hospital, only Bisrakh CHC to rely on
Basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 26 Jun 2026): Bisrakh CHC, a 30-bed community health centre, is the only government facility for the area; district hospital in Noida 35-40 min away, GIMS 50-60 min. Resident association president quoted saying Greater Noida West is home to lakhs of people. Article states Greater Noida West falls under Dadri assembly (दादरी विधानसभा क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत आने वाले ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट); Wikipedia extent says 'part of Greater Noida', without naming GNW.

Survey statement (Hindi): ईको विलेज-1 की बेसमेंट पार्किंग में बारिश का पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): In rain, the basement parking at Eco Village-1 in Greater Noida West fills with water
Basis: ETV Bharat English (10 Jul 2026, 10:28 PM IST): residents of Eco Village-1 in Greater Noida West complained of waterlogging in the basement parking area, raising vehicle-safety concerns and water seeping from the basement ceiling. Replaces the earlier Tilpata item, whose AC membership could not be confirmed. AC 62 membership of Greater Noida West: Amar Ujala (25 Jul 2026) states Greater Noida West is currently part of Dadri vidhan sabha.

Survey statement (Hindi): दादरी नगर में बारिश में पानी भर जाता है, निकासी की समस्या पुरानी
Voter says (English): In Dadri town rain waterlogs the road, and the drainage problem is long-standing
Basis: Raftar Today (page 'Last Updated: 7 Mar 2026'; original publication date not shown on the page): article describes waterlogging on rainy days on the GT Road to railway overbridge stretch in Dadri Nagar, a long-dilapidated road where residents faced waterlogging; officials and locals expect a drainage fix. Dadri Nagar is Dadri MB, inside AC 62 per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में सरकारी स्कूल, श्मशान घाट और पार्क तक नहीं
Voter says (English): Greater Noida West has not even one government school, cremation ground or park
Basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 4 Jul 2026): residents say not even one government school is available, there is no public cremation ground, and parks, stadium and Ramlila ground are lacking; a resident says 7-8 years of demand for a government multi-specialty hospital. Article states Greater Noida West falls under Dadri vidhan sabha.

Survey statement (Hindi): ग्रेटर नोएडा वेस्ट में सोसाइटी का मेंटेनेंस बढ़ा, सुविधाएं कटने का डर
Voter says (English): In Greater Noida West, society maintenance has gone up and residents fear services will be cut
Basis: NCR Khabar (last updated 6 Sep 2026; original publication date not shown): a Greater Noida West society's maintenance charges were raised; residents are unhappy; the maintenance company's email said services beyond the main facilities would be reduced; the article cites inflation, fuel prices and a guard salary rise as cost drivers. Article is filed under Dadri assembly. Source is a politics-heavy column; only the maintenance facts are used here.

Survey statement (Hindi): एयरपोर्ट के लिए जमीन देने वाले हजारों किसानों को मुआवजा मिल चुका है
Voter says (English): Thousands of farmers who gave land for the airport have received compensation
Basis: Chetna Manch (21 Apr 2026, district-level airport acquisition, not village-level): about 7,000 farmers received Rs 8,016 crore for about 2,420 hectares acquired. The article gives these figures without naming a source, and it also reports allegations from unnamed farmers and leaders about unfair compensation. AC membership: airport-level; not confined to this AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): जेवर एयरपोर्ट से अब हैदराबाद और बेंगलुरु की सीधी उड़ानें मिल रही हैं
Voter says (English): Direct flights from Jewar airport to Hyderabad and Bengaluru are now available
Basis: Daily Pioneer (16 Jun 2026): IndiGo's first commercial flight from Lucknow landed on Monday, the day before the report (the article gives no calendar date). IndiGo starts with eight daily flights to Hyderabad, Amritsar, Bengaluru and Jammu; Akasa Air starts four daily flights to Bengaluru and Navi Mumbai. District-level airport facility, not a village-level benefit.

Survey statement (Hindi): जेवर सीएचसी में नया मॉड्यूलर ऑपरेशन थिएटर बनकर तैयार हो गया
Voter says (English): A new modular operation theatre has been built and is ready at Jewar CHC
Basis: Amar Ujala (5 Oct 2026): the modular OT at Jewar CHC 'तैयार हो गया है' (has been completed) with central AC, an air filter and a 5 kW power backup. The article says patients will get better facilities once it starts operating, and gives no start date, so it is not yet operating. Chief Medical Superintendent Dr. Sarfe Jaya is quoted. The article's dateline is Yamuna City, not Jewar.

Survey statement (Hindi): एयरपोर्ट की पुनर्वास कॉलोनियां बन गई हैं
Voter says (English): The airport rehabilitation colonies have been built
Basis: Chetna Manch (21 Apr 2026), reporter's observation that the R&R colonies 'दिखने में आधुनिक हैं' (look modern). The same article reports waterlogging and job shortages in them, so this is a looks-only positive. Dayanatpur and Raunera are the only villages named; neither is confirmed inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): *एयरपोर्ट से इलाके में रोजगार और कारोबार बढ़ने की उम्मीद है
Voter says (English): *Airport is expected to bring jobs and business to the area
Basis: Inference: Daily Pioneer (16 Jun 2026) reporter's words, not a minister's quote: manufacturing, IT, hospitality, cargo and MRO are expected around the airport, 'generating employment across a region stretching from western Uttar Pradesh to Agra'; a significant share of cargo capacity is expected to serve western UP agriculture. These are expectations, not outcomes; no Jewar-specific job figures were found.

Survey statement (Hindi): एयरपोर्ट के लिए जमीन दी, मुआवजा और आवासीय भूखंड अब भी अटके हैं
Voter says (English): We gave land for the airport, but compensation and residential plots are still stuck
Basis: Press note by Bharatiya Kisan Parishad (Thakur Sudhir Chauhan, national secretary), carried by Chetna Manch (9 Oct 2026, 3:42 PM). It lists pending 10% and 5% residential plot demands, abadi regularisation and pending compensation cases from land acquisition in the Jewar airport, YEIDA, Greater Noida and Noida areas. No amounts are given. This is a farmers' organisation's claim and is district/region-level, not AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): 335 परिवारों ने नकद छोड़कर नौकरी चुनी, अब भी स्थायी नौकरी का इंतजार
Voter says (English): 335 families chose jobs over cash and are still waiting for permanent jobs
Basis: Daily Jagran (3 Dec 2025): 335 farmer families opted for jobs instead of a one-time cash settlement of Rs 5.5 lakh; the villages named include Rohi, Dayanatpur Kheda, Nangla Chhitar, Nangla Ganeshi, Nangla Phool Khan and Nangla Sharif Khan; the youths say they have been unemployed for six to seven years and protested on being offered third-party placement. AC membership unconfirmed: Rohi is named, but its tehsil was not confirmed from an opened source, and the families come from several villages.

Survey statement (Hindi): आलियाबाद में तीन साल से सड़कें पोखर बनी हैं, शिकायत का असर नहीं
Voter says (English): Aliyabad roads have turned into ponds for about three years, complaints have had no effect
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (15 Sep 2026, by Anuj Kumar): Aliyabad, also called Mehdipur, 'in Jewar'. The stretch from the panchayat building to the graveyard is waterlogged; villagers say it has been bad for about three years and complained repeatedly to the pradhan and secretary without construction. AC membership unconfirmed: the headline places it in Jewar, but its tehsil or AC was not confirmed from an opened source. Based on the page summary; the full text was cut off.

Survey statement (Hindi): म्याना की मुख्य सड़क पर जलभराव, बच्चे कीचड़ से होकर स्कूल जाते हैं
Voter says (English): Waterlogging on Myana's main road, and children wade through mud to reach school
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (7 Oct 2026, dateline Jewar, reporter Anuj Kumar): headline 'जेवर: म्याना गांव के मुख्य रास्ते पर जलभराव, स्कूल जाने में दिक्कत'. Standing water on the main road at a spot next to a primary school (the article names it as Aakalpur village's school); small children pass through the muddy road. AC membership unconfirmed: Myana's tehsil or AC was not confirmed from an opened source. Based on the page summary; no official response was visible.

Survey statement (Hindi): जेवर सीएचसी में अल्ट्रासाउंड मशीन है, पर चलाने वाला रेडियोलॉजिस्ट नहीं
Voter says (English): The Jewar CHC has an ultrasound machine, but no radiologist to run it
Basis: Amar Ujala (17 Mar 2026): Jewar CHC has an ultrasound machine, but the radiologist post has been vacant for a long time; patients needing non-pregnancy ultrasounds go to private hospitals or labs. Medical in-charge Dr. Sarfe Jeya says no action has been taken on last year's demand for a radiologist. Jewar town is the namesake of the AC, so this counts as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): दादरी-बुलंदशहर-सिकंदराबाद सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, डिवाइडर बन रहा है
Voter says (English): The Dadri-Bulandshahr-Sikandrabad road is being widened and a median divider is being built
Basis: Source: 'दादरी से चिटहेरा होते हुए बुलंदशहर और सिकंदराबाद को जोड़ने वाली सड़क के चौड़ीकरण का काम तेजी से चल रहा है'; median divider, two lanes each side and drains being built; no length stated; the stretch inside this AC is not stated, Sikandrabad is only the endpoint (town counts as inside under the namesake rule)

Survey statement (Hindi): अरनिया कमालपुर गांव में सड़क निर्माण और मरम्मत का शिलान्यास हो गया
Voter says (English): Foundation stone laid for road construction and repair in Arnia Kamalpur village
Basis: Regional MLA laid the foundation stone for road construction and repair at Arnia Kamalpur village; the rajwaha roads (Vair km 3.30 to 8.30, Talada 2.5 to 4.75, Baroda 26 to 28.906, Hasanpur 10.20 to 13.60) are pledged or 'किया जाएगा' (future), not confirmed as started; no funding amount; article names Sikandrabad constituency and Sikandrabad area; AC membership of Arnia Kamalpur village unconfirmed (not named in the Wikipedia extent list, which covers all of Sikandrabad tehsil); published 12 Nov 2024

Survey statement (Hindi): सितंबर की बारिश में फसल खराब, जिले में राहत प्रमाण पत्र मिले
Voter says (English): After the September rain damaged crops, relief certificates were given in the district
Basis: District-level: certificates for relief aid and agricultural input subsidy given at Bulandshahr collectorate auditorium from the State Disaster Mitigation Fund, for rain between 25 and 27 September 2026; number of farmers and amount not stated; no village or tehsil named

Survey statement (Hindi): चीनी मिलों ने गन्ने का पूरा पैसा खाते में भेजने की बात कही
Voter says (English): Sugar mills say they sent 100 percent of cane dues to farmers' bank accounts
Basis: District-level: four Bulandshahr mills say they sent 100 percent of 2025-26 cane dues, about Rs 1,092 crore, to farmers' bank accounts; mills named: Sabitgarh, Pahasu, Anamika, Agauta, Wave and Di Kisan; mill locations inside this AC not confirmed (Agauta is a name that may fall in the Agouta KC area, unverified); the figures are the mills' own statement

Survey statement (Hindi): सिकंदराबाद में करीब 10 करोड़ की 5 किलोमीटर सड़क बनी
Voter says (English): A 5 km road costing about 10 crore was built in Sikandrabad
Basis: Article: 'सिकंदराबाद की पांच किलोमीटर लंबी सड़क करीब 10 करोड़ की लागत से बनी है'; the road was dug up by Jal Nigam for a pipeline about four months after construction, so the benefit was short-lived; the damage is the article's main point, see negatives; the town counts as inside the AC under the namesake rule; published 6 July 2026

Survey statement (Hindi): सिकंदराबाद में ट्रिपिंग से बार-बार बिजली गुल हो जाती है
Voter says (English): Power in Sikandrabad keeps going off because of tripping
Basis: Article: 'सिकंदराबाद क्षेत्र में 33 जगह फॉल्ट होने की शिकायत ऊर्जा निगम से की गई'; cuts of 'दो से लेकर आठ घंटे' reported from the town to rural areas (district-wide report); the 'हर 15 से 25 मिनट पर' claim is Bulandshahr-wide and is not used for this AC; Sikandrabad area is inside the Sikandrabad tehsil extent; published 27 May 2026

Survey statement (Hindi): जुलाई की बारिश में सिकंदराबाद के सभी मोहल्लों में पानी भर गया
Voter says (English): In the July rain, all mohallas of Sikandrabad town were waterlogged
Basis: Article (rain of Thursday 9 July 2026): 'सिकंदराबाद नगर के सभी मोहल्लों के अलावा औद्योगिक क्षेत्र और तहसील परिसर में तहसीलदार के आवास आदि जगह जलभराव'; Sikandrabad recorded 75 mm; a single event, not a stated recurring problem; the report is district-wide but names Sikandrabad nagar; published 9 July 2026

Survey statement (Hindi): सिकंदराबाद मंडी में गंदगी का ढेर लगा है, नल खराब पड़े हैं
Voter says (English): Sikandrabad mandi has piles of filth and broken taps
Basis: Article: 'मंडी परिसर में चारों तरफ गंदा पानी, कूड़े के ढेर'; 'मंडी में लगे नल खराब पड़े हैं'; commission agents announced an indefinite strike until the mandi's cleanliness, drainage and drinking water are fixed; strike status after 14 Aug 2026 not confirmed; published 14 Aug 2026

Survey statement (Hindi): ट्रांसफार्मर के करंट से बच्चे की मौत, आरोप है शिकायत अनसुनी
Voter says (English): A child died from transformer current, villagers allege complaints were ignored
Basis: Article: a five-year-old died from current on Sunday morning in Mohalla Kala Peer, Sikandrabad Kotwali area; current ran through the iron angle supporting a transformer on the path, which is unpaved and waterlogged; villagers allege the transformer lay there for many days and repeated requests to remove it went unheeded (allegation); published 31 May 2026

Survey statement (Hindi): सिकंदराबाद की कंपनी में 12 घंटे ड्यूटी, महिलाओं को 8 हजार मिलते हैं
Voter says (English): In a Sikandrabad company, 12-hour duty and women get about 8,000 pay
Basis: Article: workers at a private company in Sikandrabad industrial area protested low pay and 12-hour shifts, demanding Rs 15,000 (women) and Rs 20,000 (men) minimum wage, and 8-hour days; the article reports women's pay of about Rs 8,000 a month; company not named; officials (ALC, SDM) promised to take demands to management; published 14 Apr 2026

Survey statement (Hindi): मेडिकल कॉलेज के नए भवन में अब इमरजेंसी के ऑपरेशन हो रहे हैं
Voter says (English): Emergency surgeries are now being done in the new medical college building
Basis: Amar Ujala, 30 May 2026, dateline Bulandshahr (verified): emergency operation theatre for seriously ill patients started in the new building of Kalyan Singh Rajkiya Medical College; acting principal Dr. Sanjay Mishra says 30 patients have been operated in the emergency OT so far; general and orthopaedic surgery first. The article names no street address, so the town (namesake rule) is the basis for AC membership.

Survey statement (Hindi): इस साल डेंगू और मलेरिया के मरीज पहले से काफी कम हैं
Voter says (English): This year dengue and malaria patients are far fewer than before
Basis: Amar Ujala, 1 Oct 2026 (verified): 8 dengue and 16 malaria cases this year, against 77 dengue and 53 malaria cases in previous years. The article does not state whether these are district or city figures; they sit in a district-wide section, so treat this as a district-level claim, not a neighbourhood fact.

Survey statement (Hindi): *सुनने में आया है कि कॉलोनियों की सड़कों की मरम्मत चल रही है
Voter says (English): *I hear colony road repairs are in progress
Basis: Inference: the only evidence is the Nagar Palika EO's own claim in the 3 Apr 2026 Amar Ujala article (verified): damaged roads surveyed, repairs in progress, all colony and mohalla roads to be fixed soon. Residents in the same article say repeated complaints were ignored, so this is not confirmed as a benefit. Field check needed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *नए भवन में 5 ऑपरेशन थियेटर का काम चल रहा है
Voter says (English): *Work is under way on five new operation theatres in the new building
Basis: Inference: a plan, not a delivered benefit. The 28 Mar 2026 Amar Ujala article (verified) says work is under way to start five operation rooms in the new building, expected from April, and that surgery was then done in one room in the old building. The 30 May 2026 article reports only the emergency and general/orthopaedic surgery start, not the five rooms. Field check needed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *हर विधानसभा में करीब 10 करोड़ के विकास कार्य मंजूर हुए हैं
Voter says (English): *Development works worth about Rs 10 crore have been approved for every assembly seat in the district
Basis: Inference, district-level: Amar Ujala, 29 Aug 2026 (verified) says about Rs 10 crore of development works was approved for each assembly constituency, within 39 roads and works costing about Rs 70 crore across the district; first Rs 25 crore instalment released; tenders being prepared, work expected to start by end of September. The article names no road in AC 65, so AC membership is unconfirmed, and the works are approved, not delivered.

Survey statement (Hindi): कालाआम, चांदपुर रोड और भूड़ चौराहे पर जगह-जगह गड्ढे, बारिश में कीचड़
Voter says (English): Potholes in many places on Kala Aam, Chandpur Road and Bhood crossing; in rain they turn to mud
Basis: Amar Ujala, 14 Sep 2026 (verified), city (नगर) section: Kala Aam, Syana Adda, Bhood Chauraha and Chandpur Road named among main city routes 'जगह-जगह टूट चुकी हैं'; rain turns them to mud and waterlogging; residents say repairs happen but the road is soon back to its old state. The two-wheeler risk and poor streetlighting point is in the district-wide section, not the city section. The 500 km figure covers the whole district.

Survey statement (Hindi): यमुनापुरम और कचहरी रोड पर कई घंटे बिजली गुल रहती है
Voter says (English): Power is cut for hours in the Yamunapuram and Kachahari Road areas of the town
Basis: Amar Ujala, 24 Aug 2026, dateline Bulandshahr (verified), town (नगर) areas: in Yamunapuram power went off around 4 am and came back around 9 am; on Kachahari Road supply was cut from about 10 am and restored about 5 pm. A resident said he was told the grid supply had been shut off. SDO Kashinath attributed the Kachahari Road outage to a feeder fault, made harder to find by rain, and said most town areas were restored within one to two hours. Rural cuts in the same article are not used.

Survey statement (Hindi): कालाआम चौराहे और कॉलोनियों की सड़कें टूटी, शिकायत के बाद भी सुनवाई नहीं
Voter says (English): The Kalaam crossing and colony roads are broken, and residents say complaints were ignored
Basis: Amar Ujala, 3 Apr 2026, dateline Bulandshahr, Nagar Palika area (verified): deep potholes on the Kalaam roundabout that endanger drivers daily; Hari Enclave road fully broken up; Yamunapur road dust reaching homes; Devipura road work stopped halfway. Residents say 'बार-बार शिकायत करने के बावजूद भी जिम्मेदार अधिकारियों ने समस्या के समाधान की ओर ध्यान नहीं दिया'. EO Nagar Palika, Dr. Ashwani Kumar, says survey done and repairs in progress.

Survey statement (Hindi): मोहल्लों में कूड़ा सड़कों पर बिखरा है, सफाई सिर्फ़ फाइलों में है
Voter says (English): Garbage lies scattered in our mohallas even though the city is shown as clean on paper
Basis: District-level article, Amar Ujala, 1 Oct 2026 (verified): 'मोहल्लों में कूड़ा सड़कों पर बिखरा है'; garbage heaps on the roads of Bulandshahr, Khurja and Sikandrabad towns; about 900 segregation centres claimed but many locked; door-to-door garbage vehicles 'run on paper and GPS'. The town named is Bulandshahr (namesake rule); no neighbourhood is named.

Survey statement (Hindi): *बारिश में सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): *In rain, water stands on the roads
Basis: Inference: the 14 Sep 2026 Amar Ujala city-roads report (verified) says rain turns roads into mud and waterlogged stretches. It does not say drains are the cause. Bulandshahr city drain complaints were not found for 2025-26; the 8 May 2026 Sikandrabad board report is a different AC. Field check needed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *स्याना से गढ़ तक की सड़क चौड़ी करने की मंजूरी मिल गई है
Voter says (English): *Approval has been given to widen the Syana to Garh road
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (11 Dec 2025) says the Syana-Garh road (SH-65, km 6 to 24, 19 km, Rs 59 crore) was approved by the CM on the Sadar MLA's proposal. Amar Ujala (24 Jan 2026) says the 19 km Bulandshahr-Syana highway widening (7 m to 10 m, Rs 58.91 crore) had its tender completed and work would begin in February. Searches in Oct 2026 found no report that work started or finished. The two reports name the road differently, the Rs 90 crore headline does not match the roughly Rs 100 crore sum of the items, and the km 6-24 stretch's membership in Syana AC is unconfirmed

Survey statement (Hindi): *स्याना-सिंभावली सड़क चौड़ी करने के लिए पैसा जारी हो गया है
Voter says (English): *Syana-Simbhaoli road widening has got its first funds
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026) says the government approved a Rs 14.44 crore estimate for the 7.35 km road and released Rs 7.22 crore as first instalment, with tender still to come. Only approval and funds are reported, no work done. The route is described as Bibinagar-Simbhaoli-NH-9; AC membership is unconfirmed

Survey statement (Hindi): *सुना है, जलभराव वाली जगहों से पानी निकालने सफाईकर्मी भेजे गए
Voter says (English): *I hear sanitation workers were sent to drain water from waterlogged spots
Basis: Inference: Syana Executive Officer Sevaram Rajbhar is quoted (Amar Ujala, 23 Aug 2026) saying sanitation workers were sent to waterlogged places to drain the water. This is the official's claim only; residents in the same article complained of silt in the drains and asked for a permanent drainage system

Survey statement (Hindi): *सुना है पहले नालियों की सफाई हो चुकी है, सफाईकर्मी लगातार लगे हैं
Voter says (English): *I hear drains were cleaned earlier and sanitation workers are working continuously
Basis: Inference: Syana Nagar Palika EO Sewaram Rajbhar is quoted (Amar Ujala, 3 Jul 2026, Bugrasi and Syana report) saying drains had been cleaned earlier and sanitation workers were continuously at work. This is the official's claim only; the same article reports drains overflowing and Syana shops flooded

Survey statement (Hindi): *बारिश से फसलों को फायदा और उमस में कुछ राहत मिली
Voter says (English): *Rain has helped crops and eased the humidity a little
Basis: Inference: a meteorologist at the Krishi Vigyan Kendra says the rain is proving a boon for crops and eases heat and humidity (Amar Ujala, 3 Jul 2026, Bugrasi and Syana report). This is a weather comment, not a delivered benefit or project; it is district-level commentary carried in a Syana-area report. No better Syana benefit was found, so it is ranked last

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश होते ही नालियों का पानी सड़कों और बाजार में भर जाता है
Voter says (English): Rain turns Syana's bazaars and main roads into waterlogged streets as drains overflow
Basis: Amar Ujala (23 Aug 2026): in Syana, low-lying areas, main roads and markets were waterlogged and drain water was seen flowing onto the roads; residents blamed silt and dirt in the drains and asked for a permanent drainage system. Amar Ujala (3 Jul 2026, Bugrasi and Syana report) says drains overflowed within minutes and Syana shops flooded, naming Main Bazaar and Kotwali Road. Amar Ujala (18 Jul 2026) says Syana's lanes were submerged, with Raj Market, Darshan Bazar and Kotwali Road under water, and vehicles stalled
