Sources: Amar Ujala 2026-08-23: https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/bulandshahr/rain-exposes-flaws-in-drainage-system-waterlogging-in-syana-shikarpur-bulandshahr-news-c-133-1-bul1016-163477-2026-08-23 | Amar Ujala 2026-07-03: https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/bulandshahr/heavy-rain-caused-waterlogging-in-the-bugrasi-and-syana-areas-while-the-subsequent-sunshine-increased-humidity-bulandshahr-news-c-133-1-bul1002-158715-2026-07-03 | Amar Ujala 2026-07-18: https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/bulandshahr/heavy-rain-in-syana-bugrasi-and-shikarpur-other-areas-still-waiting-bulandshahr-news-c-133-1-bul1002-160078-2026-07-18

Survey statement (Hindi): स्याना बाजार में अक्सर जाम लगता है, सड़क बहुत संकरी है
Voter says (English): Syana market gets jammed because the road into it is too narrow
Basis: Amar Ujala (24 Jan 2026): the Bulandshahr-Syana state highway is 7 m wide, congestion is frequent, and Aurangabad and Syana are named as towns with congested main markets. About 10,000 vehicles and roughly 60,000 people use the road daily. The earlier 5 km widening from the Shikarpur crossing did not resolve congestion on the narrow stretch beyond it

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में स्याना की बिजली भी गुल हो गई
Voter says (English): The power also went off in Syana during the rain
Basis: Amar Ujala (18 Jul 2026): power supply stayed off in Syana during the rain, while the rain also flooded lanes and students returning from school faced serious difficulty. The article does not say how long the outage lasted. Reported for one rain event only

Survey statement (Hindi): स्याना-सिंभावली सड़क अभी सिर्फ साढ़े तीन मीटर चौड़ी है
Voter says (English): Syana-Simbhaoli road is still only about 3.5 metres wide
Basis: AC membership unconfirmed. Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026): the road is currently about 3.50 to 3.75 m wide and will be raised to 5.50 m. The article describes the route from Bibinagar through Simbhaoli to NH-9, so it is not confirmed to lie inside Syana AC. The article reports no public complaint

Survey statement (Hindi): खुर्जा के जीटी रोड पर नाली नहीं, गड्ढे और पानी भरा रहता है
Voter says (English): On Khurja's GT road there are no drains, so there are potholes and standing water
Basis: District-level, not Syana AC. Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026), Khurja, Bulandshahr district: about 7 km of GT road built for about Rs 14 crore has waterlogging at several points, potholes, and no drain; PWD says only renovation and widening were sanctioned

Survey statement (Hindi): बुलंदशहर से अनूपशहर के लिए हर घंटे रोडवेज बस मिलती है
Voter says (English): Roadways buses run from Bulandshahr to Anupshahr every hour
Basis: Amar Ujala (22 Oct 2025, Ghaziabad Bureau, dateline Bulandshahr): article says buses to Anupshahar currently run every hour, about 6:30 AM to 6:30 PM, from the Bulandshahr roadways stand. Article also says extra buses start 25 Oct before Chhath and every 30 minutes once Kartik Mela begins (plans as stated). No residents quoted. Status after Oct 2025 not verified

Survey statement (Hindi): अनूपशहर गंगा पुल की मरम्मत का काम शुरू होने जा रहा है
Voter says (English): Repair work on the Anupshahr Ganga bridge is starting
Basis: Amar Ujala (7 Apr 2026, Ghaziabad Bureau, dateline Bulandshahr/Anupshahar): PWD repair and strengthening of the Ganga bridge; work to begin Wednesday 8 Apr 2026 at 7 AM; traffic on the route diverted for about 15 days. Headline says 'from today', body gives 8 Apr. No completion date stated; no residents quoted; completion not found in any source checked

Survey statement (Hindi): *बाढ़ से नुकसान वाले किसानों के खाते में 493 करोड़ रुपये आए
Voter says (English): *Rs 493 crore came into the accounts of farmers hit by floods
Basis: Inference: All India Radio (12 Oct 2026): Rs 493 crore to 9,18,091 farmers for losses from floods, heavy rain, hailstorm and cyclone; event organised in Gorakhpur. Neither Anupshahr nor Bulandshahr is named, so local receipt is not confirmed. Statewide; weak positive pending field check

Survey statement (Hindi): *शिकारपुर से अनूपशहर के लिए रोडवेज बसें चलने की योजना है
Voter says (English): *Roadways buses are planned from Shikarpur to Anupshahr and Pahasu
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (11 Dec 2025, Ghaziabad): Bulandshahr depot plans two buses each on Shikarpur-Anupshahr and Shikarpur-Pahasu routes. Article says buses are not running yet and villages are being surveyed first; no start date. A plan, not a delivered benefit, so it is weak under the positives rule

Survey statement (Hindi): *सुना है बुलंदशहर-अनूपशहर सड़क को चार लेन करने का प्रस्ताव भेजा गया है
Voter says (English): *I hear a four-lane proposal for the Bulandshahr-Anupshahr road has been sent to the state
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Ghaziabad): PWD has sent a Rs 175 crore four-lane proposal to the state; approval expected within about two months. An announcement only, not a delivered benefit; listed because no other planned benefit for Anupshahr was found in sources checked

Survey statement (Hindi): अनूपशहर का गंगा पुल खस्ताहाल है, सरिया तक बाहर दिख रहा है
Voter says (English): The Ganga bridge at Anupshahr has deep potholes and iron rods showing
Basis: Amar Ujala (21 Oct 2025, Ghaziabad Bureau): deep potholes in several places, iron rods exposed, drivers facing difficulty. PWD Assistant Engineer Satyendra Chaudhary said heavy traffic vibration causes the potholes and patch repairs would be done soon, with full fix after festivals because of labour shortage. Article says potholes were filled several times earlier but repairs did not last

Survey statement (Hindi): श्राद्ध पूर्णिमा पर गंगा स्नान की भीड़ में अनूपशहर में 10 घंटे जाम
Voter says (English): A 10-hour jam in Anupshahr when pilgrims crowded the Ganga for Shraddh Purnima bath
Basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026, Ghaziabad Bureau): jam lasted about 10 hours, Friday night to Saturday afternoon, during Shradh Purnima Ganga bath crowds. Queues from Mastram Ghat to Roopwas and about 2 km to Karanpur village on the Anupshahar-Bulandshahr road; the Anupshahar Adda to Bulandshahr Adda bypass was full. SP Dehat and CO Anupshahr came onto the roads with police; CO blamed sudden vehicle pressure and drivers going the wrong way. No future measures announced; no residents quoted. Mastram Ghat, Roopwas and Karanpur are not named in the Wikipedia extent; they are within Anupshahr town and its approaches, so membership is unconfirmed beyond the town itself

Survey statement (Hindi): गंगा उफान पर, घाट डूबे, गंगा द्वार की सड़क तक पानी पहुंचा
Voter says (English): Ganga flood covered Anupshahr ghats and the road to Gangadwar, and farm crops went under water
Basis: Patrika (published 31 Jul 2026, datelined Anupshahr, Bulandshahr): Ganga rose quickly at Anupshahr; several main ghats submerged; flood water reached the main road to Gangadwar; flood water covered forest and farm land in Ahar, Mubarakpur, Margpur, Sirora, Torai and Bachchi Khera; maize, jowar, bajra and sugarcane standing in fields began to go under water. Ahar and Serora (Sirora) appear in the Wikipedia extent of AC 67; Gangadwar and the ghats are within Anupshahr town. The source URL sits under a bijnor-news path but its content concerns Anupshahr

Survey statement (Hindi): बुलंदशहर-अनूपशहर सड़क सिर्फ 10 मीटर चौड़ी है, रोज डेढ़ लाख गाड़ियां चलती हैं
Voter says (English): The Bulandshahr-Anupshahr highway is only 10 metres wide with about 1.5 lakh vehicles a day
Basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr edition): the state highway is 10 m wide now; it was widened from 7 m about eight years ago; about 1.5 lakh vehicles use it daily. PWD has sent a Rs 175 crore four-laning proposal. The road runs between Bulandshahr and Anupshahr; AC membership of the Bulandshahr end is not confirmed, so this is partly district-level

Survey statement (Hindi): सुबह के जाम में सब्जी किसानों को मंडी जाने में परेशानी
Voter says (English): Morning traffic jams make it hard for vegetable farmers to reach the Anupshahr and Bulandshahr mandis
Basis: Amar Ujala (8 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr edition): thousands of farmers from villages near the highway bring vegetables daily to the Bulandshahr and Anupshahr mandis; heavy morning traffic causes them significant trouble. No farmer quoted; the claim is the article's own. District-level along the highway

Survey statement (Hindi): चीनी मिलों ने गन्ने का पूरा पैसा किसानों के खाते में भेज दिया
Voter says (English): Sugar mills have sent the full cane payment into farmers' accounts
Basis: District-level, not Dibai-specific: ChiniMandi (8 Jul 2026) says the four Bulandshahr mills of the 2025-26 season (Sabitgarh; Anamika at Agauta; Wave at Bulandshahr; Di Kisan at Anupshahr) have sent 100% of the payment for cane bought to farmers' bank accounts, total Rs 1,09,209.12 lakh. The article does not mention Dibai or any mill in Dibai

Survey statement (Hindi): वीसीबी जलने पर भी करीब तीन घंटे में बिजली लौट आई
Voter says (English): Power came back in about three hours after the VCB fire
Basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026): a technical fault set fire to a VCB machine around 10:24 PM on the Monday night, cutting supply in Dibai for about three hours; power returned once the fault was fixed. Dibai consumers had faced low voltage, tripping and undeclared cuts for the three days before it. A single restoration, not a lasting fix

Survey statement (Hindi): डिबाई में सामूहिक विवाह योजना से 150 शादियां हुईं
Voter says (English): 150 couples were married under the state mass-marriage scheme in Dibai
Basis: Janmat News (19 Feb 2026): a mass-marriage event under the Chief Minister's Samuhik Vivah scheme was held at Ravan ki Patwari in Dibai nagar, with 150 weddings. The article does not say how many couples were from Dibai, so this is a scheme event held in Dibai, not a count of Dibai beneficiaries

Survey statement (Hindi): *डिबाई में मंडी चलती है
Voter says (English): *A mandi operates in Dibai
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026) names Mandi Hardev as a spot where waterlogging blocked traffic in Dibai, which implies a mandi operates there; no source found on crop sales, procurement or prices at the Dibai mandi (searches this round returned only other districts). Field check needed

Survey statement (Hindi): *डिबाई में सामुदायिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र है
Voter says (English): *Dibai has a community health centre
Basis: Inference: a search result listed a Community Health Centre Dibai on the Bulandshahr district hospital page, but that page returned HTTP 503 when fetched, so it is not cited. No 2026 report on services at the Dibai facility was found. Field check needed; replaces an earlier tehsil-office item, which was a geography fact and not a benefit

Survey statement (Hindi): डिबाई में रोज़ 10 से 12 घंटे बिजली कटती है
Voter says (English): Power is cut for 10 to 12 hours a day in Dibai
Basis: Amar Ujala (13 Jul 2026): a table of daily average outage hours gives Dibai as 10 से 12 घंटे (Shikarpur, AC 69, is in the same table row and is not used here). The table sits in a report on a protest in Bulandshahr city, and the article also says most villages face 8 to 10 hours of daily cuts. Chief Engineer Sanjeev Kumar blamed higher summer load for the faults. Dibai is the namesake town of the AC, so it counts as inside the AC

Survey statement (Hindi): डिबाई में बारिश हुई तो बाजार और दुकानों में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): Market shops in Dibai flood when it rains
Basis: Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026): after about 45 minutes of heavy rain, Mahadev Chauraha, Paith Chauraha, Holi Gate and Bada Bazar had two to three feet of water, and shops on Railway Road were flooded. Shopkeepers were angry and councillors said shopkeepers have long demanded a fix; the EO and chairperson were asked to solve it. The article says the rain exposed the municipality's drainage claims. No official response is quoted

Survey statement (Hindi): डिबाई में बार-बार ट्रिपिंग और बिना बताए बिजली कटौती से परेशानी
Voter says (English): Power trips and goes off without notice in Dibai
Basis: Amar Ujala (1 Jul 2026): residents of Dibai faced unannounced cuts and repeated tripping for ten days; flour mills could not grind wheat and children's studies were affected. Trader representative Deepak Agarwal gave a memorandum to XEN Rahul Ratn Bodhi seeking advance notice of cuts. The XEN attributed the disruptions to transformer overloading, and the article says work is ongoing on feeders one and two

Survey statement (Hindi): डिबाई का बाईपास अधूरा पड़ा है और हाईवे पर जाम लगता है
Voter says (English): Dibai bypass is incomplete and highway jams happen in Dibai
Basis: Amar Ujala (14 May 2025, district plan article): says the incomplete bypass in Dibai and Sikandarabad will be completed, and gives a 6.80 km Dibai bypass costing Rs 45.50 crore as a proposal; no work reported as started or complete, and the plans await government approval. Amar Ujala (2 Sep 2026): people were stuck in highway jams in Dibai during the rain. No 2026 status report on the bypass was found, so 'incomplete' rests on the 2025 article

Survey statement (Hindi): सुबह सड़कों पर कचरे के ढेर लगे मिलते हैं
Voter says (English): Garbage heaps are found on the streets in the morning
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala (1 Oct 2026), in an article on cleanliness in Bulandshahr, says garbage heaps are found on the streets in the morning. Dibai nagar palika is named only in a list of district bodies, with no Dibai-specific figure, so this is not counted in ac_specific_negatives

Survey statement (Hindi): अनूपशहर वाली सड़क का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया है
Voter says (English): Widening work on the Anupshahr road has started
Basis: Amar Ujala (12 May 2025), opened and checked: widening of the Anupshahr-Shikarpur road has begun; cost Rs 31.28 crore; work started after the first instalment of over Rs 10 crore. The article says the road connects Shikarpur and Khurja; it does not name the stretch or give a completion date. Route-level, so AC membership of the stretch is not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): *सड़कों, नालियों और पुलियों पर 2.90 करोड़ खर्च होंगे
Voter says (English): *2.90 crore is to be spent on town roads, drains and culverts
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026), opened and checked: Shikarpur Nagar Palika Parishad will spend Rs 2.90 crore on 20 works, mainly roads, drains and culverts, funded from the 15th Finance Commission, State Finance Commission and municipal funds. No start or completion date is given, so this is planned spending, not delivered work.

Survey statement (Hindi): *मुफ्तीवाड़ा और कोटशेर खां में पानी की पाइपलाइन बिछने वाली है
Voter says (English): *Water pipelines are to be laid in Muftiwara and Kotsher Khan
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026), opened and checked: tenders are complete for about Rs 1.22 crore of works, including 783 m of pipeline in Muftiwara (ward 4, Rs 16.48 lakh) and 1,490 m in Kotsher Khan (ward 19, Rs 15.07 lakh). The works are planned; no start date and no completion are reported.

Survey statement (Hindi): *सुना है बैनामे के सात दिन में मुआवजा खाते में आ जाता है
Voter says (English): *I hear compensation reaches accounts within seven days of the deed
Basis: Inference: ETV Bharat (2 Jul 2026), opened and checked: SDM Ravindra Pratap Singh says payment is sent to farmers' accounts within 7 days of the official sale deed; 62 deeds are done so far, and about 6 km of the Bulandshahr-Jewar expressway route is affected in Shikarpur tehsil. This is an official claim. The article has no farmer confirmation and gives no amount, so delivery is not verified.

Survey statement (Hindi): *शहर के 15 हैंडपंप ठीक कराए जाने हैं
Voter says (English): *Fifteen handpumps in town are to be repaired
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026), opened and checked: re-boring of 15 India Mark handpumps is among the Rs 1.22 crore Nagar Palika works, and the article says tenders for all works are complete. Repair is planned; the article does not report it as done.

Survey statement (Hindi): हल्की बारिश में सड़कों, बाज़ार और सीएचसी के सामने पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): Light rain floods our roads, the market and the front of the CHC
Basis: Amar Ujala (23 Aug 2026), opened and checked: Balaji Market and the Kotwali turn in Shikarpur town are waterlogged; residents blame garbage in a culvert and drains not cleaned on time; EO Neetu Singh says drains have been cleaned and problem spots will be inspected. Royal Bulletin (23 Aug 2026): water on the main roads and crossings of Shikarpur Nagar after light rain. Dynamite News (9 May 2026): waterlogging in front of the CHC and block office in the Nagar Palika area. Amar Ujala video (7 Jul 2026): the same spot on the Khurja-Shikarpur road in front of the CHC and block office. The Syana part of the 23 Aug article is excluded because Syana is not confirmed inside this AC. The Girls Inter College spot appears only in a photo caption, so it is not used.
Sources: Amar Ujala 2026-08-23: https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/bulandshahr/rain-exposes-flaws-in-drainage-system-waterlogging-in-syana-shikarpur-bulandshahr-news-c-133-1-bul1016-163477-2026-08-23 | Royal Bulletin 2026-08-23: https://royalbulletin.in/uttar-pradesh/bulandshahr/-draft--add-your-title/article-219097 | Dynamite News 2026-05-09: https://hindi.dynamitenews.com/uttar-pradesh/bulandshahr-news-shikarpur-nagar-palika-waterlogging-chc-block-road-issue | Amar Ujala 2026-07-07: https://www.amarujala.com/video/uttar-pradesh/bulandshahr/video-shikarpur-municipalitys-development-claims-exposed-2026-07-07

Survey statement (Hindi): नया केबल डालने के बाद भी शिकारपुर में 36 घंटे बिजली गुल रही
Voter says (English): Power was off for 36 hours in Shikarpur even after a new cable was laid
Basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026), opened and checked: the outage in Shikarpur continued for 36 hours even after a new cable was laid. A storm and rain caused breakdowns on the Mangraul and Chitsaun feeders, which the article links to more than 10 villages; the Executive Engineer says a 33 KVA line broke down in the storm. Feeder village membership is not confirmed. The article's Dibai and other areas are not part of this item.

Survey statement (Hindi): आरोप है, सीएचसी में दवा बाहर से लेने को कहा जाता है
Voter says (English): It is alleged that patients are told to buy medicines from outside the CHC
Basis: Knews (10 Sep 2026), opened and checked: allegations that poor and labour patients at Shikarpur CHC are told to buy medicines from private medical stores, and a local allegation of a commission racket between the CHC in-charge and some doctors. The article says these allegations are not independently confirmed. CMO Dr Sunil Kumar Dohri says all necessary medicines are available in hospitals. Allegation only, not verified.

Survey statement (Hindi): आवारा पशु फसल उजाड़ते हैं और गन्ने का बकाया पड़ा है
Voter says (English): Stray cattle wreck our crops and sugarcane dues are still pending
Basis: Amar Ujala (14 Jul 2025), opened and checked: BKU farmers' padyatra from Jakhaita village to Shikarpur tehsil listed crop damage by stray cattle, low electricity, damaged roads, unpaid sugarcane dues and fake fertiliser and seed; a memorandum went to the SDM and CO and no official response is reported. Jakhaita's tehsil membership is not confirmed. ETV Bharat (4 Apr 2026, district-level BKU demands) repeats the stray-animal and sugarcane-dues demands. No 2026 Shikarpur-specific update found.

Survey statement (Hindi): खुर्जा-शिकारपुर सड़क 15 साल से जर्जर है
Voter says (English): The Khurja-Shikarpur road has been dilapidated for about 15 years
Basis: Amar Ujala (20 Dec 2024), opened and checked: the Khurja-Shikarpur road has been dilapidated for about 15 years; approval was given for about Rs 22.11 crore (article: Rs 22 crore 10 lakh 94 thousand) for about 35 villages, and construction is still to start after budget approval. Amar Ujala video (7 Jul 2026) confirms waterlogging on this road in front of the Shikarpur CHC and block office, which confirms the Shikarpur town stretch. The 2024 figure is dated. The article gives 13.650 km in the body (13 km in the lead). The Khurja end may lie in another AC, which is not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): खुर्जा में मेडिकल कॉलेज शुरू हुआ, अब कई इलाज यहीं हो जाते हैं
Voter says (English): Khurja's medical college has started, and many treatments now happen here
Basis: Acting principal Dr. Sanjay Mishra says the Kalyan Singh Government Medical College (named for Khurja) started about two years ago and now teaches MBBS. The article says residents earlier went to Meerut or Noida for many treatments and that many services are now local. The article's dateline is Bulandshahr (district-level ground report); the college itself is named Khurja.

Survey statement (Hindi): खुर्जा का 660 मेगावाट बिजली यूनिट चालू हुआ, रोजगार की उम्मीद है
Voter says (English): A new 660 MW power unit has started at Khurja, and people expect jobs from it
Basis: Amar Ujala (30 May 2025): PM inaugurated the first 660 MW unit virtually on 30 May 2025; the article's timeline gives operations from 26 January 2025. Project executive director says more than about 5,000 people will get employment (a forward projection, not a count). Article places the plant at Dashehra village in the Khurja area. THDC's own page says the plant land lies in four villages of Khurja Tehsil, which is the AC's Wikipedia extent, but does not name Dashehra. AC membership at village level unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): ओडीओपी और सरकारी मदद से बर्तनों के कारोबार को फायदा हो रहा है
Voter says (English): ODOP scheme and government support are helping pottery traders grow their business
Basis: Trader Anshul Goyal says government support and ODOP promotion are helping pottery reach markets and grow; his account, no sales figures. District-level: the article's dateline is Bulandshahr and the fetched ODOP section does not name Khurja.

Survey statement (Hindi): चमन विहार कॉलोनी में सड़क और नाली का काम शुरू हुआ है
Voter says (English): Road and drain work has started in Chaman Vihar colony of Khurja city
Basis: Amar Ujala (11 Sep 2026), dateline Khurja: Nagar Palika Adhyaksh inaugurated the start on Thursday of about 200 m cemented road and drain in Ward 22 Chaman Vihar colony, about Rs 22 lakh for this colony. Headline says Rs 1.10 crore and body Rs 1.20 crore for four colonies; the body's breakdown adds to 1.20 crore. Work has started; other road works in the report are still future.

Survey statement (Hindi): 21 कॉलोनियों में सड़क और नाली के लिए पैसा मंजूर हो गया है
Voter says (English): Money has been sanctioned for road and drain work in 21 colonies of Khurja
Basis: Amar Ujala (28 May 2026): about Rs 2.78 crore proposal for road and drain work in 21 colonies approved, budget sanction received, departmental tender nearly complete; DUDA work still in future tense, so construction has not started. Headline says 2.78 lakh, body says crore. Sanction only, not a completed work; kept because four searches found no completed Khurja road, drain or other project in 2026.

Survey statement (Hindi): खुर्जा में रोज 6 से 8 घंटे बिजली कटौती झेलनी पड़ती है
Voter says (English): We face 6 to 8 hours of power cuts every day in Khurja
Basis: Amar Ujala district-wide article (13 Jul 2026, Bulandshahr). Its table of average daily outages gives Khurja's own row as 6 to 8 hours (district-level article, Khurja row). Causes listed: summer overload, tripping and low voltage in the city, dilapidated lines and faults in rural areas. Chief Engineer says the system will be restored soon.

Survey statement (Hindi): जीटी रोड पर नाली नहीं, पानी भरता है और सड़क टूट रही है
Voter says (English): There are no drains on the GT road, so water collects and the road is breaking up
Basis: Amar Ujala (Khurja dateline, 30 Sep 2026): 7 km GT Road stretch from Agwal Cut to Kailash Hospital Cut, renovated for about Rs 14 crore, broke within about a year and a half; no drains, waterlogging at Dadu Pottery, Naveen Sabzi Mandi and other points; a pottery entrepreneur says waterlogging hurts business. PWD XEN says only renovation and widening were sanctioned and drain work depends on other departments submitting proposals.

Survey statement (Hindi): गांधी मार्ग पर डिवाइडर हटने से सुबह से शाम तक जाम रहता है
Voter says (English): Jams on Gandhi Marg run from morning to evening since the dividers were removed
Basis: Amar Ujala (Khurja dateline, 6 May 2026): temporary dividers at Padam Singh Gate and Kabari Bazar crossings removed after vehicles broke cement barricades. A shopkeeper says jams run from about 10 AM to 8 PM; shopkeepers say sales fell up to 40 percent (their claim); ambulances and school vehicles have trouble getting through. Nagar Palika EO says the damaged barricades were sent for budget approval.

Survey statement (Hindi): जटिया अस्पताल की 1919 की इमारत जर्जर है, दीवारें कमजोर हो गई हैं
Voter says (English): The 1919 building of Jatiya hospital in Khurja is dilapidated and its walls have weakened
Basis: Amar Ujala (7 Sep 2026; district-wide report with a Khurja focus): Sri Lakshman Das Jatiya Rajkiya Chikitsalaya Khurja building dates to 1919, walls and lintels deteriorating; old staff quarters dilapidated with chhajjas that could fall. A chhajja of a roughly 100-year-old building on Subhash Marg fell on 19 July 2026 with no major accident. ADM says process under way to build new buildings.

Survey statement (Hindi): खुर्जा जंक्शन पर पीने का पानी नहीं, छांव भी कम, यात्री परेशान
Voter says (English): Khurja Junction has no working drinking water and little shade, and passengers face trouble
Basis: Amar Ujala (4 Jun 2026; byline Ghaziabad Bureau, filed under Bulandshahr news; about Khurja Junction): Amrit Station 2.0 redevelopment (Rs 12.5 crore, virtual foundation Feb 2024) not finished; platforms 1 to 5 lack working drinking water, coolers on 1 to 4 broken. A commuter says the tin shed covers only about 30 m of the 600 m platform 3-4 stretch (his claim). Station Superintendent says old sheds will be removed after station work and a letter has gone out for cooler repairs.

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर-जट्टारी सड़क का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया, जाम कम होने की उम्मीद है
Voter says (English): Khair-Jattari road widening has started and people hope it will ease the jams
Basis: Article says construction began 13 April from Arrana Kante to Hamidpur Yamuna bridge, cost about Rs 88 crore, target one year; MLA inspected the work

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर सीएचसी में लू के लिए चार बेड का कूलिंग वार्ड बन गया
Voter says (English): A four-bed cooling ward for heat relief has been set up at Khair CHC
Basis: Cooling ward built next to CHC emergency with four beds; CHC president said the heat relief room will run as a permanent arrangement

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर का निबंधन दफ्तर खुला, पहले ही दिन 120 रजिस्ट्री हुईं
Voter says (English): Khair's registration office reopened and 120 registrations were done on the first day
Basis: Registration work reopened on 3 July 2026 after the lawyers' protest ended; 120 registrations on the first day

Survey statement (Hindi): *खैर में जाम से राहत के लिए अलीगढ़-पलवल मार्ग पर बाईपास प्रस्तावित है
Voter says (English): *A bypass on the Aligarh-Palwal road is proposed at Khair to ease jams
Basis: Inference: only a proposal awaiting board approval on 13 Aug 2026, not a started or completed project; included because no completed Khair-specific relief was found. Source gives 10 km, 35 m wide, about Rs 70 crore

Survey statement (Hindi): *खैर की 114 सड़कों के लिए 169 किमी की योजना आई है
Voter says (English): *A plan for 114 roads totalling 169 km has come for Khair constituency
Basis: Inference: a plan figure from an Aligarh-division roads article, not confirmed as sanctioned or started; only the Khair constituency mention is Khair-specific

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर मंडी में पांच घंटे से ज़्यादा जाम, बच्चे देर से स्कूल पहुंचे
Voter says (English): More than five hours of jam at Khair mandi made students reach school late
Basis: Jam from about 4 AM on Friday 25 Sep 2026 at Khair mandi on the Aligarh-Palwal road lasted over five hours; private school managers said students were delayed 1.5 to 2 hours; CO said police were short-staffed; paddy arrivals rose because Igalas and Dhanipur mandis were closed

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर में पथवारी मंदिर से सोमना बाईपास तक सड़क टूटी पड़ी है
Voter says (English): The road from the Pathwari temple to Somna bypass in Khair is badly broken
Basis: Article names the road from the historic Pathwari temple in Khair to Somna bypass as badly damaged, about one km, in poor condition for a long time; the article is district-wide (Aligarh division roads) but names Khair

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर का निबंधन दफ्तर 25 दिन बंद रहा, रजिस्ट्री का काम ठप रहा
Voter says (English): Khair's registration office stayed shut for 25 days and registry work stopped
Basis: Khair tehsil registration work was shut 25 days; lawyers boycotted the office from 9 June 2026 in protest against privatisation of registration; reopened 3 July 2026

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर मंडी में फसल खरीद के समय भारी जाम लगता है
Voter says (English): Khair mandi gets heavy jams during crop purchases
Basis: Mandi Samiti Khair (in Khair town, namesake rule). DM visited on 31 Oct 2025 and heard traders; jams during paddy, wheat and potato purchase; token system to be introduced and alternate vehicle routes asked for. Replaces the earlier millet item, which was tehsil-level and not AC-specific

Survey statement (Hindi): हम किसान गर्मी में बिजली कटौती से परेशान हैं, बिजलीघर पर ज्ञापन दिया
Voter says (English): We farmers are troubled by power cuts in the heat and gave a memorandum at the substation
Basis: District-level: farmers and villagers gave a memorandum at Jattari substation to the SDO, warning of protest; article gives no hours and names no village; does not name Khair; AC membership of Jattari unconfirmed

Survey statement (Hindi): थानपुर और हींसेल में इंटरलॉकिंग सड़कें बन गई हैं
Voter says (English): Interlocking roads have been built in Thanpur and Hinsail villages.
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 Mar 2026): the Barauli MLA inaugurated a ~200 m interlocking road in Thanpur, stated as built from MLA fund, and a 600 m interlocking road from Hinsail to Nagla Sarua (funding not stated). A 1,600 m Hinsail-Nagla Sarua road only got a foundation stone, so it is not counted.

Survey statement (Hindi): यात्री शेड और बारात घर विधायक ने बनवाए
Voter says (English): A passenger shed and a barat ghar were built by the Barauli MLA.
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024) reporter states the Barauli MLA got a passenger shed, barat ghar and similar works built; the article covers three ACs and the line sits in its Barauli section. Reporter's statement only; no cost or completion date given.

Survey statement (Hindi): हरदुआगंज उप मंडी में किसानों का धान खरीदा जा चुका है
Voter says (English): Farmers' paddy has already been bought at Harduaganj sub-mandi.
Basis: Subkuz (13 Oct 2026) says the wet paddy kept at Harduaganj sub-mandi had already been bought from farmers. Weak positive: shows procurement took place, not that prices or payment were good.

Survey statement (Hindi): पलवल-अलीगढ़ हाईवे का निर्माण शुरू हो गया है
Voter says (English): Construction of the Palwal-Aligarh highway has started.
Basis: District-level, not confirmed inside Barauli AC: Amar Ujala (19 Jul 2025) says construction of NH 334D Palwal-Tappal-Aligarh (72 km, department target two years) started at Kheshwar crossing. Khair, Jattari, Andla, Arrana, Rajpura and Lodha are named; Barauli is not.

Survey statement (Hindi): *हरदुआगंज-पिपली-भमराउला संपर्क मार्ग का पहला किलोमीटर बन चुका है
Voter says (English): *The first kilometre of the Harduaganj-Pipli-Bhamraula link road is built.
Basis: Inference: a Newstrack search summary (about 100 days old, 2026) says the first 1 km of this 3.3 km link road is complete and the rest (2.3 km) awaits sanction from Mandi Parishad. The Newstrack page returned HTTP 403 on two attempts and was not opened, so no URL is cited. Harduaganj is in Barauli AC; Pipli and Bhamraula are not confirmed inside it.

Survey statement (Hindi): तीन साल से सड़क टूटी है, गड्ढों में बारिश का पानी भरता है
Voter says (English): The road has been broken for three years, and rainwater fills its potholes.
Basis: Amar Ujala (30 Mar 2026): link road from a nagar panchayat (photo caption: Jawan) to the Barauli-Aligarh road, about 3 km, broken for three years; serves about six villages including Sumera and Faridpur. Gram pradhan says complaints were made many times with no action. AC membership: Wikipedia's Barauli extent lists Jawan Sikanderpur; the article itself does not name the nagar panchayat.

Survey statement (Hindi): हरदुआगंज उप मंडी में खुले में रखा धान बारिश में भीगा
Voter says (English): Paddy kept in the open at Harduaganj sub-mandi got soaked in the rain.
Basis: Subkuz (13 Oct 2026): thousands of quintals of paddy kept in the open at Harduaganj sub-mandi were soaked by rain. The 20% loss fear and Rs 10 crore estimate in the article are for Khair mandi, so they are not used here. Harduaganj Nagar Panchayat is in Barauli AC per Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): खेड़ा बुजुर्ग साधु आश्रम मार्ग जर्जर है, आए दिन लोग चोटिल होते हैं
Voter says (English): The Sadhu Ashram road in Kheda Bujurg is badly broken, and people keep falling and getting hurt on it.
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024): former Kheda Bujurg pradhan Chandrabhan Singh says 'साधु आश्रम मार्ग बेहद जर्जर है' and 'आए दिन लोग गिरकर चोटिल हो रहे हैं'. The article places Kheda Bujurg in its Barauli section; it covers three ACs, and no later report was found for this road.

Survey statement (Hindi): मेमडी-छलेसर, मुजफ्फरा-गोधा, गोपालपुर-कासिमपुर सड़कें जर्जर हैं
Voter says (English): The Memdi-Chhaleser, Mujaffara-Godha and Gopalpur-Kasimpur roads are broken.
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024) lists these three roads under its own heading 'बरौली विधानसभा की जर्जर सड़कें' (dilapidated roads of Barauli assembly), with no speaker or individual description. Weak: a list, not a quote; field check needed. The article covers three ACs.

Survey statement (Hindi): *आवारा पशु खेत उजाड़ देते हैं, फसल बचाना मुश्किल
Voter says (English): *Stray cattle destroy crops and farmers struggle to protect their fields.
Basis: Inference: no Barauli- or Aligarh-specific 2024-26 report was found in about 40 searches (Hindi and English). Only western and Bundelkhand UP coverage turned up. Not confirmed as a Barauli problem; a field check is needed.

Survey statement (Hindi): गांवों में डिजिटल लाइब्रेरी और शमशान घाट का उद्घाटन हो गया
Voter says (English): Digital libraries and cremation grounds in village panchayats have been inaugurated
Basis: Amar Ujala (19 Apr 2026, verified): the state minister inaugurated about Rs 5 crore of projects in Atrauli block: 33 kshetra panchayat works (Rs 2.5 crore), digital libraries in 33 gram panchayats (Rs 1.32 crore), cremation grounds in 4 gram panchayats (Rs 1.20 crore). The article names no villages, so each work's exact AC membership is not confirmed. Block-level, and the works are delivered (inaugurated), not just planned.

Survey statement (Hindi): सड़कों के टेंडर हो गए, अब काम शुरू होने का इंतजार है
Voter says (English): Tenders for new roads are done, now we wait for construction to start
Basis: Amar Ujala (11 Oct 2026, verified): 12 roads worth about Rs 21 crore, tendered under the CM rural road scheme. Six are in Atrauli rural area, about Rs 9.96 crore by addition (e.g. Tarechi to Sirsa Rs 2.32 crore; Pendhara to Rajgaon Gazipur Rs 1.95 crore; Pahadgarhi to Nahal Panehra Rs 1.64 crore). The report names these under Atrauli vidhan sabha. The article says construction will start soon. Tender stage only; no completion reported.

Survey statement (Hindi): गांवों की कच्ची सड़कें पक्की बनाने का काम मंजूर हुआ है
Voter says (English): Unpaved village roads in Atrauli block have been sanctioned for construction
Basis: Amar Ujala (1 Nov 2024, verified): about Rs 2.5 crore from the kshetra panchayat for roads in several villages of Atrauli block that had been unpaved since independence; tenders issued; construction to finish in three months. Block-level report, no village list, so AC membership is not separately confirmed. Dated 2024; completion not confirmed in any later source found.

Survey statement (Hindi): अमृत सरोवर बना तो सुबह-शाम यहीं घूमने आते थे
Voter says (English): Amrit Sarovar built in Naoari had villagers walking there morning and evening
Basis: Amar Ujala (19 Mar 2026, verified): Amrit Sarovar in Naoari gram panchayat (Atrauli block), built in 2023, with benches and a walking path around it. Villagers initially came morning and evening and sat by the clear water. Past benefit only; the pond has since dried (see negative 5). Naoari's AC membership is not confirmed: it is not in the Wikipedia extent and no source named it.

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में सफाई और हरियाली का अभियान शुरू हुआ है
Voter says (English): A cleanliness and greening drive has started in town
Basis: Amar Ujala (28 May 2026, verified): Atrauli municipal board installed Green Atrauli-Clean Atrauli cutouts and lighting at the Avantibai crossing and an I Love Atrauli selfie point at the roadways bus stand; the chairman says a tree-planting drive will run in every ward (no dates). The article quotes no residents by name and reports no measurable results. Campaign stage, so the weakest positive here.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजली 10 की जगह 4-5 घंटे मिलती है, मक्का खतरे में है
Voter says (English): Power comes for only 4-5 hours instead of 10, and the maize is at risk
Basis: Amar Ujala (28 May 2026, verified): for about 15 days farmers on the Paneha feeder (Atrauli area; Rajatau and Nahal named) got 4-5 hours instead of 10, with repeated trips and no daytime irrigation; maize at risk; farmers demand 12 hours. The JE blames overloading and says it will be resolved soon. Second source, Aligarh Media (18 Jul 2026, local outlet, verified): Panehra village (Atrauli) faced a power crisis and low voltage, and villagers gave a memorandum to the DM on 15 Jul. AC membership: Nahal Panehra is named under Atrauli vidhan sabha in the 11 Oct 2026 Amar Ujala report. Panehra village's own AC membership is not separately confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): अतरौली-गनियावली-गाजीपुर सड़क पर गड्ढे हैं, बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
Voter says (English): Atrauli-Ganiyavli-Gazipur road is full of potholes and gets waterlogged in rain
Basis: Amar Ujala (26 May 2026, verified): the Atrauli-Ganiyavli-Gazipur road is in poor condition; the Yuva Pahal president says large potholes and waterlogging disrupt travel in rains, hitting school children, patients and farmers. The BDO says a complaint letter will go to PWD. A dharna on the same demand was held on 1 Jan 2023 with no action since. The road starts in Atrauli town, so AC membership follows the namesake-town rule.

Survey statement (Hindi): काली नदी पर पुल सिर्फ कागज पर है, अभी तक बना नहीं
Voter says (English): Kali river bridge is still only on paper, not built yet
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 May 2025, verified): a 120 m bridge over the Kali river on Godha Road, Jawan area, near Gobli village, estimated at Rs 16.50 crore. The UP Setu Nigam sent the detailed plan to the state government; sanction pending; construction not started. The article says the bridge would spare residents on both banks long detours. Gobli is in the AC extent on Wikipedia. No later report on approval or construction was found in searches, so the status after May 2025 is unconfirmed; a field check is recommended. The earlier Wire (2022) claims were dropped because the page body could not be read.

Survey statement (Hindi): यूरिया के लिए लाइन में लगते हैं, मिलती है बस दो बोरी
Voter says (English): We queue for urea from morning, but get only two bags
Basis: Amar Ujala (5 Aug 2025, verified): at the Atrauli PCF centre and cooperative society, farmers from Gaziapur, Harchandpur and Khera queued from about 5 am in rain; they needed 5-10 bags and got two each; there was a scuffle with police; private shops also lacked urea. The secretary says distribution matched the stock. Dated 2025; no later urea report for Atrauli was found. The PCF centre is in Atrauli town, so it counts under the namesake-town rule.

Survey statement (Hindi): अमृत सरोवर सूख गया है, वहां गोबर रखा जा रहा है
Voter says (English): The Amrit Sarovar has dried up and cow dung is kept there
Basis: Amar Ujala (19 Mar 2026, verified): the Amrit Sarovar in Naoari gram panchayat, Atrauli block, built in 2023, has dried; dung cakes are stacked on the flag platform and dung is spread across the dry pond. The report implies neglect but quotes no villager. Naoari's AC membership is not confirmed, so this is not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

Survey statement (Hindi): *छर्रा की मंडी में फसल बेचने की अपनी जगह है
Voter says (English): *The Chharra mandi gives our farmers a local place to sell their crops
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026, checked) names the Chharra Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti as the site where a porter was injured in a dispute with traders on 22 Sep. The article does not describe farmers using the mandi or praising it; appreciation is inferred. Chharra town is the namesake town of AC 74, so the mandi is inside the AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): गालिबपुर की प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सड़क गांवों को मुख्य रास्ते से जोड़ती है
Voter says (English): The PM Gram Sadak road from Galibpur is the main link for our villages
Basis: Amar Ujala (2 Jul 2026, checked): resident Vinod Kumar says the about 1.5 km road from Galibpur gram panchayat (Gangiri block) to the Chharra-Kasganj route is 'कई गांवों के लोगों के लिए मुख्य संपर्क मार्ग है' (the main link for many villages). AC membership unconfirmed: Galibpur is not named in the AC's Wikipedia extent. District-level. The road is in poor condition, so this praises its role, not its state.

Survey statement (Hindi): *त्योहार की सवारी के लिए छर्रा में सुरक्षा का इंतज़ाम हुआ
Voter says (English): *Security arrangements were made for the festival procession in Chharra
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (10 Oct 2026, checked on the video page; headline and summary only) reports the SSP inspected the Ram Barat procession route in Chharra, the Ravan dahan site, and gave security instructions to organisers. The report does not record any resident's praise; appreciation is inferred. A security check is not a delivered benefit, so this is a weak positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): *छर्रा की 79 सड़कों के लिए 216 करोड़ रुपये का बजट है
Voter says (English): *Rs 216 crore budget is set aside for 79 roads in Chharra
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked) budget list gives Rs 216 crore for 79 roads of 250 km in the Chharra assembly area. This is a budget allocation, not a started or completed work; no resident praise is reported. Weak positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): *अतरौली-कासगंज राज्य मार्ग से छर्रा के बाहर के शहरों तक जाते हैं
Voter says (English): *The Atrauli-Kasganj state road takes us to towns beyond Chharra
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked) calls the Atrauli-Kasganj road a state highway that passes Pali Morh and Chharra Adda. The article names no destination towns and reports no resident praise; the appreciation is inferred and this is the weakest positive in the set.

Survey statement (Hindi): अतरौली-कासगंज रोड पर पाली मोड़ से छर्रा अड्डा तक गहरे गड्ढे हैं
Voter says (English): The Atrauli-Kasganj road has deep potholes from Pali Morh to Chharra Adda
Basis: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked), reporter narration with no named speaker: 'अतरौली-कासगंज रोड पर पाली मोड़ से छर्रा अड्डा तक एक किलोमीटर के टुकड़े में गहरे गड्ढे हैं', state highway. Article covers 17 ACs in four districts, so it is district-level, but Chharra Adda is inside Chharra town (Chharra NP), listed in the AC's Wikipedia extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): छर्रा मंडी में पल्लेदार पर व्यापारियों के हमले का आरोप है
Voter says (English): A porter at the Chharra mandi is alleged to have been assaulted by traders in a dispute
Basis: Amar Ujala (28 Sep 2026, checked): porter Raju was injured on 22 Sep at the Chharra Krishi Utpadan Mandi Samiti; the family alleges assault by two traders; FIR against 8 named persons and about 90 people in all (about 30 women); villagers allege police were not taking the case seriously (allegation only). Traders' version not in article. Police gave a different time for the incident (about 10:30 pm) than the family (about 8 pm).

Survey statement (Hindi): नानऊ से छर्रा-सांकरा सड़क जर्जर हो चुकी है
Voter says (English): The Nanau to Chharra-Sankra road is damaged
Basis: Amar Ujala (14 Sep 2026, checked), reporter narration with no named speaker: 'अकराबाद में जीटी रोड स्थित नानऊ चौराहे से छर्रा-सांकरा जाने वाली सड़क भी जर्जर हो चुकी है'. Nanau Chauraha is on GT road in Akarabad, and Akarabad KC is in AC 74's extent (Wikipedia), so the road starts inside AC 74. Sankra is not confirmed. Counted as AC-specific. The article covers 17 ACs in the Aligarh division, so the source is district-level.

Survey statement (Hindi): गालिबपुर की सड़क में गहरे गड्ढे हैं, बारिश में निकलना मुश्किल
Voter says (English): The Galibpur road has deep potholes and is hard to use in rain
Basis: Amar Ujala (2 Jul 2026, checked): the PMGSY road from Galibpur gram panchayat (Gangiri block) to the Chharra-Kasganj route has deep potholes that fill with rainwater, so drivers cannot judge their depth; resident Vinod Kumar says 'हालत इतनी खराब हो चुकी है कि बारिश में निकलना मुश्किल हो जाता है'. Galibpur is not named in the AC 74 extent on Wikipedia: AC membership unconfirmed, so not counted as AC-specific. No official speaks in the article.

Survey statement (Hindi): *इलाज के लिए अलीगढ़ 40 किमी दूर, सिर्फ सड़क से जा सकते हैं
Voter says (English): *For treatment, Aligarh is 40 km away and it can only be reached by road
Basis: Inference: Wikipedia (Chharra Rafatpur, undated, checked) says the town is '40 km from district headquarters Aligarh' and 'The only way to commute to this place is by road'. The page names no hospital or health service; the health-access claim is inferred from distance and road-only access. The page describes it as a nagar panchayat in Aligarh district, and the AC page lists Chharra NP in the extent.

Survey statement (Hindi): *खबर छपते ही सोलर तार बदला गया, नलों में पानी आने लगा
Voter says (English): *After a newspaper report, the stolen solar wire was replaced and water reached taps
Basis: Inference: Siyakhas (Jawan block, Aligarh district) is outside Koil per the AC-76 polling-part list check, so this is not an AC 75 benefit. Kept only because no Koil-extent positive was found this round. Amar Ujala 15 Sep 2026 (checked): 'गांव सिया खास में बनी पानी की टंकी व पाइप लाइन से सोलर वायर चोरी हो गई थी।'; a new wire was installed and 'ग्रामीणों के घरों में अब नलों से पानी आना शुरू हो गया है।' The article says the original report ran on Monday (14 Sep). Koil does not appear in the article.

Survey statement (Hindi): *कोल में विकास कार्यों का लोकार्पण और शिलान्यास हुआ
Voter says (English): *Development works in Koil were inaugurated and their foundations laid
Basis: Inference: an event report, not a delivered benefit. Amar Ujala live blog 22 Jun 2026 (verified): the CM inaugurated and laid foundations for works in Aligarh Sadar, Koil assembly and the municipal corporation at Numaish Ground; no Koil project is named

Survey statement (Hindi): *अलीगढ़ में 462 करोड़ से ज्यादा की 85 विकास परियोजनाओं का लोकार्पण हुआ
Voter says (English): *85 development projects worth over Rs 462 crore were inaugurated in Aligarh
Basis: Inference: an event, not a delivered benefit. Sangrah Rajneeti (verified): 85 projects worth over Rs 462 crore for Aligarh, with the event covering Aligarh city and Koil assembly constituency; no Koil project is named. The article dateline is 23 Jun 2026 and it describes the event as Monday (22 Jun)

Survey statement (Hindi): *अलीगढ़ में 105 करोड़ की ड्रेन योजना मंजूर, काम अभी शुरू नहीं हुआ
Voter says (English): *In Aligarh, a Rs 105 crore RCC drain plan is approved but work has not begun
Basis: Inference: city-wide approval only; no Koil ward is named. Amar Ujala 6 Aug 2026 (verified): State Level Apex Committee approved Rs 105.28 crore for a 6.2 km RCC drain from Kwarsi crossing to Boneere nala; construction waits for the CM's final approval

Survey statement (Hindi): *कई चीनी मिलों ने गन्ना किसानों का पूरा भुगतान कर दिया
Voter says (English): *Many sugar mills have paid cane farmers their full dues
Basis: Inference: statewide figure only. UNI 16 Sep 2026 (verified): 102 sugar mills made 100 pc payment to cane farmers in the 2025-26 crushing season; 23 cooperative mills paid Rs 2,820 crore. No Aligarh or Koil figure in the report

Survey statement (Hindi): मैरिस रोड पर नालियां ओवरफ्लो, गंदा पानी सड़क पर आता है
Voter says (English): Drains on Maris Road overflow and dirty water comes onto the road
Basis: Amar Ujala (21 Sep 2024, checked): 'पानी की निकासी के लिए जो नालियां हैं वह भी ओवरफ्लो रहती हैं जिससे गंदा पानी सड़क पर आ जाता है' and 'बरसात के दिनों में तो यहां से निकलना संभव ही नहीं है'. Amar Ujala (19 Sep 2025, checked): 'इतना ही नहीं नाला सड़क से ऊंचा बना दिया गया', and residents' drain defect complaints led to a three-member probe. Koil is not named in either report; Maris Road is placed in AC 75 by the AC-76 polling-part list the user supplied (that list was not re-opened: aligarh.nic.in was not found in search). The 2025 report's minister and probe details are not used in the statement.

Survey statement (Hindi): कोल की सड़कों का टेंडर हुआ, पर बनना अभी शुरू नहीं हुआ
Voter says (English): Koil roads have tenders but construction has not started
Basis: Amar Ujala 11 Oct 2026 (verified): tenders issued for 12 roads worth Rs 21 crore under the Mukhyamantri Gramin Sadak Yojana, six of them in the Koil seat (e.g. Manoharpur Kayastha to Bhakrola); PWD Superintending Engineer says construction will start soon and no work has started yet

Survey statement (Hindi): क्वार्सी बाईपास का बंबा गंदगी से भरा है, सफाई पर ध्यान नहीं
Voter says (English): The bamba on Quarsi bypass is clogged with garbage and not being cleaned
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (5 Mar 2026, checked, headline and summary): 'अलीगढ़ के क्वार्सी बाईपास स्थित बंबा गंदगी से अटा हुआ है', 'जनता बंबा में गंदगी डाल रही है', and 'बंबा की सफाई करने वाला विभाग का इस ओर ध्यान नहीं है'. Quarsi is placed in AC 75 by the AC-76 polling-part list the user supplied (not re-opened). No official or resident is quoted in the visible text.

Survey statement (Hindi): कोल तहसील के रजिस्ट्री दफ्तर में लेनदेन का आरोप है
Voter says (English): There is an allegation of transactions at the Koil tehsil registry office
Basis: Amar Ujala 1 Apr 2026 (verified): a seven-minute video circulating online alleges transactions at the Koil tehsil registry office; AIG (Stamp) has started an inquiry. Allegation only, no findings reported

Survey statement (Hindi): *गंगीरी में 24 घंटे में सिर्फ चार-पांच घंटे बिजली मिल रही है
Voter says (English): *Farmers say they get only four to five hours of power in 24 hours at Gangiri
Basis: Inference: district-level, Gangiri's Koil membership is not confirmed. Amar Ujala 21 Sep 2026 (verified): farmers sat in at Gangiri power station, saying the government orders more supply but they get four to five hours in 24. The report does not mention Koil or any assembly seat

Survey statement (Hindi): शाहजमाल का पानी निकालने के लिए तीन नए पंप चल रहे हैं
Voter says (English): Three new high-capacity pumps are running to drain Shahjamal rainwater
Basis: ETV Bharat (5 Aug 2026): the corporation decided to install three pumps of 10,000 litres per minute each, reported running by late night, adding about 30,000 litres per minute of drainage capacity; the Municipal Commissioner called freeing the Shahjamal area from waterlogging the top priority. The article does not name the pumping station site. Shahjamal polling parts are on the AC 76 ERO/AERO list (parts 146, 150-156, 185), so AC membership is confirmed
Sources: ETV Bharat 2026-08-05: https://www.etvbharat.com/hi/state/aligarh-nagar-nigam-takes-major-action-over-waterlogging-water-works-gm-removed-ups26080500439 | Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in) 2026-10-13: https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s38f85517967795eeef66c225f7883bdcb/uploads/2026/10/17918775271413.pdf

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर रोड की सड़क बन रही है, पर काम धीमा है
Voter says (English): Khair Road's Rs 29 crore road is under construction, but work is slow
Basis: Amar Ujala (22 May 2026): road from Hiralal ki puliya to Nada Pul chauraha on Khair Road under the CM Grid scheme, about Rs 29.58 crore; the Municipal Commissioner fined the contractor PPS Builders Rs 20 lakh for slow progress; streetlight pole fitting had not started; no completion date given. Under construction, not completed. Khair Road polling parts (AC 76 list parts 19-24 and 128-129) are in AC 76 only
Sources: Amar Ujala 2026-05-22: https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/aligarh/20-lakh-fine-on-contractor-for-slow-pace-of-road-construction-aligarh-news-c-2-gur1004-978831-2026-05-22 | Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in) 2026-10-13: https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s38f85517967795eeef66c225f7883bdcb/uploads/2026/10/17918775271413.pdf

Survey statement (Hindi): पंचवटी कॉलोनी की खराब सड़क छात्र के वीडियो के बाद बननी शुरू हुई
Voter says (English): Bad road in Panchavati Colony began being rebuilt after a student's video
Basis: ETV Bharat (14 Aug 2026): after a Panchavati Colony student posted a video of the road on 29 Jul 2026, the Nagar Nigam started work at about Rs 45 lakh in ward 24 (Devsaini area), with a two-month target. Construction started, not completed. The article names no assembly constituency. District-level item: Panchavati Colony is on neither the AC 76 nor the AC 75 ERO/AERO list, so AC membership is unconfirmed

Survey statement (Hindi): तालानगरी में ट्रिपिंग कम करने के लिए छोटा सब-स्टेशन चालू है
Voter says (English): A small substation near UPCDA is being used to cut tripping in Talanagari
Basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026): XEN Rahul Katihar said a small substation near UPCDA is an alternative arrangement (वैकल्पिक इंतजाम) to reduce tripping in Talanagari; a permanent site is still being sought. The article names no assembly constituency. Talanagari is on neither the AC 76 nor the AC 75 ERO/AERO list, so AC membership is unconfirmed; district-level item

Survey statement (Hindi): *शाहजमाल में खराब पंप ठीक हो गया है
Voter says (English): *A faulty pump was repaired in the waterlogged Shahjamal area
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (4 Aug 2026) quotes the Water Department general manager that a faulty pump has been repaired, in a report on Shahjamal waterlogging. The article does not say which pump or station it is, or confirm that it is in the Shahjamal area. Field check needed

Survey statement (Hindi): शाहजमाल में कई दिनों से सड़क पर गंदा पानी भरा रहता है
Voter says (English): Shahjamal streets stay waterlogged with dirty water for several days
Basis: Amar Ujala (4 Aug 2026): waterlogging for several days on a route in Shahjamal; on Monday people had to walk through dirty water and a vehicle carried the procession's alam. Shahjamal, Babri Mandi, Phool Chauraha and Charkhwalan Chauraha are named. The Water Department general manager said a faulty pump was repaired and a new 1,000 kilolitre pumping station (about Rs 16 crore) is proposed at Charkhwalan Chauraha. AC membership: Shahjamal parts are on the AC 76 ERO/AERO list (parts 146, 150-156, 185)
Sources: Amar Ujala 2026-08-04: https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/aligarh/mourners-reached-karbala-through-dirty-water-2026-08-04 | Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in) 2026-10-13: https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s38f85517967795eeef66c225f7883bdcb/uploads/2026/10/17918775271413.pdf

Survey statement (Hindi): रामघाट और खैर रोड पर बारिश में दुकानों तक पानी घुस जाता है
Voter says (English): Rain water gets into shops on Ramghat and Khair Road
Basis: Amar Ujala (4 Jul 2026, city-level reporting): the drains report lists localities along the Ramghat Road route where water enters homes and shops (including Shahjamal Eidgah Road, Gular Road and Khair Road); Gular Road, Khair Road and Melrose Bypass were still waterlogged 36 hours after Wednesday's rain. AC membership: Khair Road parts (AC 76 list parts 19-24 and 128-129) are in AC 76 only; Ramghat Road has parts in both AC 76 (parts 110-112) and AC 75 Koil, so the Ramghat stretch is shared. The flooding list is city-level, not AC-only
Sources: Amar Ujala 2026-07-04: https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/aligarh/condition-of-drains-in-aligarh-2026-07-04 | Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in) 2026-10-13: https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s38f85517967795eeef66c225f7883bdcb/uploads/2026/10/17918775271413.pdf

Survey statement (Hindi): खैर रोड, सासनी गेट और रामघाट में बिजली बार-बार जाती है
Voter says (English): Power keeps going off and tripping on Khair Road, Sasni Gate and Ramghat
Basis: Amar Ujala (14 Aug 2026): power went off in the Khair Road area around 10 PM; residents of Sasni Gate, Medical Road and others had no supply for hours; resident Satish Maheshwari said power had been tripping repeatedly since morning in ADA Colony, Avantika Phase-1 and Ramghat Road and warned appliances could be damaged. The Superintending Engineer (Urban) said teams were sent and supply restored. AC membership: Khair Road (AC 76 parts 19-24, 128-129) and Sasni Gate (parts 321-328) are on the AC 76 ERO/AERO list, and not on the AC 75 list. Medical Road is on neither list and is not counted
Sources: Amar Ujala 2026-08-14: https://www.amarujala.com/uttar-pradesh/aligarh/residents-of-several-areas-faced-inconvenience-due-to-power-outages-aligarh-news-c-2-gur1004-1043498-2026-08-14 | Aligarh district ERO/AERO BLO list, AC 76 (aligarh.nic.in) 2026-10-13: https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s38f85517967795eeef66c225f7883bdcb/uploads/2026/10/17918775271413.pdf

Survey statement (Hindi): तालानगरी में रोज़ बिजली ट्रिप होती है, फैक्ट्रियों का काम रुकता है
Voter says (English): Power tripping every day in Talanagari, factories lose production
Basis: Amar Ujala (27 Sep 2026): tripping has become a daily problem in the Talanagari industrial area, where more than 1,000 factories operate; supply comes from a 132 kVA substation at Bounar about 11 km away; a new substation has been sought for three years without a site. The article names no assembly constituency. Talanagari is on neither the AC 76 nor the AC 75 ERO/AERO list, so AC membership is unconfirmed and this item is not counted as AC-specific

Survey statement (Hindi): रामघाट रोड पर बिजली गई तो पीने के पानी की भी दिक्कत हुई
Voter says (English): Power cuts on Ramghat Road also left people short of drinking water
Basis: Amar Ujala (22 Aug 2026): supply was cut from morning to late night on Friday; Choudhary Vihar-Ramghat Road was among the affected areas; the article says the outage also caused a drinking water shortage; the Superintending Engineer (Urban) said supply was restored once faults were fixed. The Maris Road feeder is not used here, because Maris Road polling parts are in AC 75 (Koil). Ramghat Road parts are in both AC 76 and AC 75, and the article does not say which stretch, so AC membership is unconfirmed and this item is not counted as AC-specific

Survey statement (Hindi): *मुरसान-इगलास सड़क चौड़ी होने की मंजूरी मिली, जाम से राहत की आस
Voter says (English): *Approval came for widening the Mursan-Iglas road, and relief from jams is hoped for
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Hathras (11 Oct 2026) reports the Rs 5.84 crore widening was approved by the state and says residents of Mursan, Iglas and nearby villages hope for relief. Final financial sanction is pending and no work has started, so this is not a delivered benefit. The 3 km stretch runs from Mursan (Hathras side) toward Iglas; AC membership of the stretch is unconfirmed

Survey statement (Hindi): *इगलास-गोरई और इगलास-मुरसान मार्ग पर पुल बनाने के टेंडर निकले
Voter says (English): *Tenders are out for bridges on the Iglas-Gorai and Iglas-Mursan roads
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Aligarh (10 Oct 2026): PWD HQ sanctioned about Rs 7 crore for six small bridges across Iglas and Chharra ACs, and tenders are issued for all six (PWD SE). The article names an Iglas-Gorai road bridge at km 3 (Rs 2.17 crore) and an Iglas-Mursan road bridge at km 5 (Rs 2.11 crore). Tender stage only; no construction start or completion reported

Survey statement (Hindi): *इगलास के बाहर चार लेन बाईपास का प्रस्ताव, मंजूरी का इंतजार
Voter says (English): *A four-lane 8 km bypass outside Iglas town is proposed, awaiting sanction
Basis: Inference: The India Daily (updated 4 Jul 2026) reports an 8 km four-lane bypass outside Iglas town on Aligarh-Mathura SH-80, estimated at Rs 152 crore, as part of six bypasses worth Rs 703 crore. The article says the proposals are awaiting approval and have been sent to headquarters, so this is a plan, not a sanctioned or built project

Survey statement (Hindi): *इगलास में फसल रखने के लिए 25 से ज्यादा कोल्ड स्टोरेज हैं
Voter says (English): *Iglas has more than 25 cold storage centres where farm produce can be kept
Basis: Inference: the Wikipedia Iglas town article says there are over 25 cold storage centres in Iglas for storing agricultural produce. The page is undated and this is an infrastructure fact, not a reported benefit, so it stays flagged. Not verified against a recent local report

Survey statement (Hindi): *इगलास में एसएसपी खुद पैदल गश्त पर निकले, सुरक्षा का भरोसा दिलाया
Voter says (English): *The SSP himself walked the patrol in Iglas and assured people of safety
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Aligarh (29 Sep 2026): the SSP's foot patrol in Iglas took place on 28 Sep; he visited main markets and sensitive areas (not named), talked to people and assured them of safety. This is a police action, not a report of residents' appreciation, so it stays flagged

Survey statement (Hindi): आलू का भाव आधा रह गया, लागत भी नहीं निकल रही
Voter says (English): Potato prices have halved in Aligarh and farmers are not recovering their costs
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific. Amar Ujala Aligarh (16 Mar 2026): potato prices in Aligarh roughly halved compared with last year; farmers quoted from Iglas area (Badhakalan) and other villages say costs are not being recovered; buyers stopped at Rs 200-250 per katta. Amar Ujala Aligarh (27 Jun 2026): cold storage owners asked for a Rs 200 per quintal subsidy; 135 cold storages in Aligarh district are full and farmers owe operators money

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश से इगलास मंडी बंद, धान की खरीद रुकी पड़ी है
Voter says (English): Rain has shut the Iglas mandi and paddy purchase is stuck
Basis: Amar Ujala Aligarh (13 Oct 2026, 2:13 PM): Monday rain stopped paddy loading at the Iglas mandi; traders cannot buy paddy from farmers; mandi space is short; the trader association said the mandi would stay closed Tuesday and reopen Wednesday. This is a short weather closure and the article records traders' problems, not farmers' complaints

Survey statement (Hindi): मुरसान-इगलास की संकरी सड़क पर भारी वाहन आमने-सामने आते ही जाम
Voter says (English): The narrow Mursan-Iglas road jams whenever heavy vehicles meet head-on
Basis: Amar Ujala Hathras (11 Oct 2026): the road is narrow so vehicle pressure is constant, and a jam forms when heavy vehicles meet head-on. The Rs 5.84 crore widening is approved but final financial sanction is pending and no work has started. The stretch runs from Mursan (Hathras side) toward Iglas; AC membership is unconfirmed and not counted as AC-specific

Survey statement (Hindi): अलीगढ़ में छुट्टा गोवंश से फसलों का नुकसान हो रहा है
Voter says (English): Stray cattle damage crops across Aligarh district
Basis: District-level, not AC-specific. Amar Ujala Aligarh (5 May 2026): farmers at an indefinite sit-in at the Tappal block premises said stray cattle and nandi bulls are damaging crops and demanded a ban on stray animals. Tappal is not in Iglas AC, and the article does not mention Iglas

Survey statement (Hindi): हादसे के बाद पीड़ित परिवार को मदद के लिए तहसील में धरना
Voter says (English): After a road accident, the victim's family sat on dharna at the tehsil seeking help
Basis: Amar Ujala Aligarh (13 Oct 2026): villagers of Badhakhurd held a dharna at the Iglas tehsil office demanding withdrawal of a police report filed after a trailer was set on fire and the road blocked, and financial help for the family of Shivkumar alias Shiva, killed in a road accident on the Hathras road on 23 Sep, and for a seriously injured youth. The tehsil office is in Iglas town (Iglas is a town and tehsil per Wikipedia), but Badhakhurd village is not confirmed inside this AC. Counted as AC-specific by place only; no outcome reported

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में नालों की सफाई का अभियान चल रहा है
Voter says (English): A drive to clean the city's drains is under way
Basis: Chairperson Shweta Chaudhary inspected drain cleaning on Aligarh Road from Ram Mandir to Khemka Petrol Pump (Nagar Palika Parishad Hathras). Article gives 29 drains in total; 18 cleaned by the municipality, 11 of them finished; 13 more through outsourcing. The stated numbers do not add up (18 + 13 = 31, not 29). Work status after 30 May 2026 not confirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): आवारा गोवंश के लिए शहर में स्थायी गोशाला बन रही है
Voter says (English): A permanent gaushala for stray cattle is being built in the city
Basis: Permanent gaushala on Jalesar Road in the city, on sewage farm land, initially about 500 cattle, about Rs 1.65 crore, full amount released; construction in final phase with completion targeted for October. EO Rohit Singh said it will shelter stray cattle roaming the city. Article dated 29 Sep 2025; operational status after October 2025 not verified (searches found no 2026 update).

Survey statement (Hindi): तीन रेल फाटकों पर ओवरब्रिज का सर्वे हो गया
Voter says (English): Survey done for overbridges at three city rail gates
Basis: Northeast Railway team surveyed Bagla College Road (gate 308-C), Bijli Cotton Mill Tiraha (307-C) and Iglas Road (310) on Friday 25 Sep 2026. Survey done only; no approval, budget or timeline. Railway PRO Safdar Hussain said no gate will be closed until an overbridge, underpass or other facility is provided.

Survey statement (Hindi): मेंडू से हाथरस जंक्शन रेल लिंक का फाइनल सर्वे शुरू हो गया
Voter says (English): Final location survey for Mendu to Hathras Junction rail link has started
Basis: Final location survey for a rail link from Mendu station to Hathras Junction has started, expected to finish by end of November 2026; DPR to follow. Not approved or funded, so this is a started step, not a delivered benefit. Mendu Nagar Panchayat is inside the AC per the Wikipedia extent (Mendu NP of Hathras Tehsil).

Survey statement (Hindi): *मंदिरों के रास्ते ठीक हो रहे हैं, ऐसा सुनने में आया है
Voter says (English): *Temple roads are said to be getting repairs
Basis: Inference: only an official claim. EO Rohit Singh said roads in the city are being repaired and other routes will be fixed before the festival; the same article reports no completed repair. Gaurav Path proposal for Mursan Gate Road awaits state approval. An official statement alone is not a delivered benefit, so this is flagged and should be replaced in a field check if a completed repair is found.

Survey statement (Hindi): सासनी-जलेसर का रेलवे ओवरब्रिज बंद है, नीचे की सकरी सड़क पर रोज जाम
Voter says (English): Sasni-Jalesar railway overbridge was closed to vehicles and the narrow road below jams daily
Basis: Rs 6 crore overbridge on the Sasni-Jalesar road; large potholes within about two months of opening; closed to vehicles about a month before the 29 Sep 2026 report, repairs described as slow. Traffic diverted to a narrow unpaved service road where two heavy vehicles cannot pass at once; gate closures cause 20-30 minute waits; residents take 5-6 km detours. AC membership confirmed: Wikipedia extent for AC 78 includes Sasni Tehsil, and Hathras district has no separate Sasni AC (only 78, 79 Sadabad, 80 Sikandra Rao).

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में गलियों और सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है, चलना मुश्किल
Voter says (English): When it rains, water collects on city lanes and roads, and walking gets hard
Basis: Ward 13 (Balram Colony) lane still unpaved; Rs 8.9 lakh estimate of June 2025 not yet placed before the board; IGRS complaints with no result. Ward 3 (Awas-Vikas Colony) concrete road dug for pipeline and not restored, water standing for months. Ward 6 Meeti: new road raised about two feet above lanes so water does not drain. Nagla Chaubey-Water Works road in poor condition for about 25 years; Top Road waterlogged even without rain (residents' claim).

Survey statement (Hindi): रेल फाटक पर रोज जाम, लंबे इंतजार से परेशानी
Voter says (English): Daily jams and long waits at city rail gates
Basis: Article says the Bagla College Road, Bijli Cotton Mill Tiraha and Iglas Road gates cause daily jams and gates staying closed for hours; the overbridge plan is meant to end this. The jam description is the reporter's framing, not a direct quote from residents; no closure durations are given.

Survey statement (Hindi): मंदिर जाने वाली सड़कें टूटी हैं, पानी भरा रहता है
Voter says (English): Roads to the city's temples are broken, and water stays on them
Basis: Four temples in Hathras city: Bauhare Wali Devi (Mursan Gate route, CC road broken; article says over 20,000 use it daily); Chamunda Devi on Jalesar Road (potholes and drain water; about 10,000 devotees); Chamunda Devi Ramanpur (drain water and mud); Hathrasi Devi (waterlogging and mud; about 20,000 devotees). Footfall figures are the article's own estimates.

Survey statement (Hindi): *शहर की सड़कों पर आवारा गोवंश घूमते हैं
Voter says (English): *Stray cattle roam the city streets
Basis: Inference: the only source (29 Sep 2025) is the EO's statement that the gaushala will shelter stray cattle roaming the city. No resident complaint, count or 2026 report was found for Hathras city, so this is flagged and not counted as AC-specific.

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, ज्यादातर सीमेंट का काम हो चुका
Voter says (English): The road through Sadabad town is being widened, and most of its concrete work is done
Basis: Amar Ujala (31 May 2026): the 2.025 km urban stretch is being widened from 7 m to 10 m at about Rs 3 crore; about 1,100 m is cement-concrete work, of which 925 m is already complete. No completion date. The headline calls the route Sadabad-Raya, while the body calls it Sadabad-Mathura (29.6 km total, of which PWD Hathras handles 12.6 km); the positive is limited to the Sadabad town stretch. Town-level, inside the Nagar Panchayat.

Survey statement (Hindi): बस स्टैंड पर प्याऊ और प्रतीक्षालय बन गए, गर्मी में राहत
Voter says (English): A drinking water kiosk and a waiting room have been built at the bus stand, giving relief in the heat
Basis: Amar Ujala video report (published 14 Jul 2026; the inauguration was on the Monday before, i.e. 13 Jul) says a pyau (free drinking water point) and a passenger waiting room near the Sadabad bus stand were inaugurated by the local MP and MLA, on the initiative of the Nagar Panchayat chairperson. The report says the facilities give travellers relief from heat and rain. Completed facility, so a delivered benefit. Town-level, inside the Nagar Panchayat.

Survey statement (Hindi): पानी की दो नई टंकियां करीब अस्सी प्रतिशत बन चुकी हैं
Voter says (English): Two of the new water tanks under Amrit 2.0 are about 80 percent built
Basis: Amar Ujala (31 Mar 2026), sidebar of the Amrit 2.0 report: 4 new overhead tanks planned, 2 are 80 percent complete; target completion stated as June 2026, which has passed with no later update found. The same article says the Rs 43.19 crore plan is practically impossible to deliver on the ground because of water quality, so this is a weak, dated positive, not a working water supply.

Survey statement (Hindi): समाधान दिवस में कुछ शिकायतें मौके पर ही निपट गईं
Voter says (English): At a grievance day, some complaints were settled on the spot
Basis: Dainik Bhaskar (published 16 May 2026): a Sampoorna Samadhan Diwas joint hearing was held in Sadabad tehsil with the MLA, the DM and the SP. 235 complaints were received across the district, and 15 were resolved on the spot. District-level figures (the event covered all four tehsils); the article does not say how many complaints came from this AC.

Survey statement (Hindi): मारघाट रोड उपकेंद्र की खराबी उसी दिन ठीक हुई, बिजली आ गई
Voter says (English): A power fault at the Marghat Road substation was repaired and supply came back the same day
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 Sep 2026): a cable box fault in the cold feeder at the 33/11 kV Marghat Road substation in Sadabad cut supply for about 2,000 consumers from about 8 AM; XEN said it was repaired and supply restored, about 1:30 PM. Single incident and an official account, so this is the weakest positive. The same incident is used in negative 2.

Survey statement (Hindi): यहां का पानी खारा और भारी है, बिना फिल्टर पीना नामुमकिन है
Voter says (English): The water here is salty and heavy, and it is impossible to drink without a filter
Basis: Amar Ujala (31 Mar 2026), Sadabad Nagar Panchayat: test borings for proposed tubewells show TDS 'above 1800-2000' (the article's drinking-water standard is below 500); the Jal Nigam Executive Engineer says the tubewell sites are still being sought and the current reading is 2000. Residents without RO filters say they have no option but to drink it; a resident says it is too heavy and salty to drink without filtering. The main text gives 18 proposed tubewells and the sidebar 20; the TDS figure is quoted as stated. Town-level, inside the Nagar Panchayat.

Survey statement (Hindi): बिजली जाने पर हैंडपंप से पानी भरना पड़ता है
Voter says (English): When power goes, we have to fetch water from handpumps
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 Sep 2026): about 2,000 consumers in Sadabad were without power for about five hours after a fault at the 33/11 kV Marghat Road substation (Town One and Cold feeders), until about 1:30 PM. Residents had to fetch water from handpumps, and flour mills stopped. The article does not record a public complaint.

Survey statement (Hindi): बाजार की सड़क चार साल खराब रही, अभी पूरी नहीं बनी
Voter says (English): The main market road was broken for four years and is still not fully rebuilt
Basis: Amar Ujala (7 Jun 2026), headline 'after four years' (चार साल बाद बनी सादाबाद के मुख्य बाजार की सड़क): about 1,100 m from Ganesh Dwar to Agra Chungi, about Rs 99 lakh, by the Nagar Panchayat. Work done overnight covered a large part of the stretch; the rest is for a later phase, with no completion date. The article describes residents travelling on a damaged surface for years, with no direct quotes from residents. Town-level, inside the Nagar Panchayat.

Survey statement (Hindi): बारिश में सड़कों पर पानी भर जाता है, नालियां ठीक नहीं
Voter says (English): When it rains, water collects on the roads, and the drains are not working properly
Basis: Amar Ujala (21 Jun 2026): Rs 98.01 lakh of drain works sanctioned for the Nagar Panchayat from the 15th Finance Commission tied grant, to replace old drains including at Salempur Tiraha (Ward 08) and on Mathura Road; the article names waterlogging at Salempur Tiraha as the problem. Only administrative and financial sanction is reported, no work started. Amar Ujala (29 Sep 2026, video): the DM ordered a sanitation drive from 1 October focused on draining waterlogged areas in Nagar Panchayat Sadabad. The voter line is a paraphrase of these reports.

Survey statement (Hindi): सादाबाद-मथुरा सड़क जर्जर है, काम अभी शुरू हो रहा है
Voter says (English): The Sadabad to Mathura road is still broken, and repair work is only starting
Basis: Amar Ujala (31 May 2026): the 29.6 km Sadabad-Mathura road is described as dilapidated. The Mathura-side stretch (about 10.4 km) renovation is approved at about Rs 4.77 crore; the tender is finished and construction is being started. No completion date. AC membership unconfirmed for this road: the Wikipedia AC page names no tehsils or villages, and the article does not say which stretches are in Sadabad AC. Used as the fifth, lower-confidence negative; not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

Survey statement (Hindi): शहर में हर घर जल की पाइपलाइन बिछ गई
Voter says (English): Har Ghar Jal pipelines have been laid through the town
Basis: Brajanchal (8 Jul 2026): road restoration followed pipeline laying under the Har Ghar Jal scheme in Sikandrarao town; the article does not say taps are running. Sikandrarao town is counted as inside AC 80 under the namesake-town rule (Wikipedia extent wording 'Hathras Tehsil'; field check advised).

Survey statement (Hindi): सिकंदराराऊ सहित तीन सीटों पर 143 विकास कार्यों का लोकार्पण हुआ
Voter says (English): 143 development works were launched across the Hathras-district seats, including Sikandra Rao
Basis: DNP (28 Jun 2026) and ITDC (28 Jun 2026): Rs 548 crore, 143 projects across the Hathras, Sikandra Rao and Sadabad constituencies; ITDC says inaugurated and foundation stones laid. No per-seat split or Sikandra Rao amount given. Launch event, not verified works on the ground.

Survey statement (Hindi): *हर सीएचसी पर मां और बच्चा देखभाल यूनिट बनाने की योजना है
Voter says (English): *Every Hathras CHC is to get a mother and child care unit
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (22 Feb 2026) says a Mother and Child Care Unit is planned at every CHC in Hathras district and that Sikandrarau CHC work will start soon. Planned only, not delivered; no Sikandrarau-specific amount or date.

Survey statement (Hindi): *नगर में सड़क-नाली के लिए 59.20 लाख का प्रस्ताव है
Voter says (English): *Rs 59.20 lakh of town roads and drains proposed for Sikandrarao wards
Basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (16 Jun 2026) says CC road and drain proposals of Rs 59.20 lakh for Sikandrarau wards were sent to the government for approval; not sanctioned yet. Planned only, and the same proposal is also negative 2. Weak as a positive.

Survey statement (Hindi): *हाथरस के सातों सीएचसी का कायाकल्प होने वाला है
Voter says (English): *Hathras district plans renovation of all seven CHCs
Basis: Inference: same Amar Ujala article (22 Feb 2026) says all seven Hathras CHCs are to be renovated; district-level plan, no amount, no start date, and status as of Oct 2026 not found.

Survey statement (Hindi): हर घर जल की पाइपलाइन के बाद सड़कें धंस गईं, गड्ढे बन गए
Voter says (English): Residents say roads sank and got potholes after the Har Ghar Jal pipe digging
Basis: Brajanchal (8 Jul 2026): residents say restored roads were not repaired to standard; after rain several roads sank and potholes formed, including inside the tehsil campus. Residents allege trenches were not backfilled and compacted before asphalt/CC work. No official or contractor response in the article. Sikandrarao town is counted as inside AC 80 under the namesake-town rule (Wikipedia extent wording 'Hathras Tehsil'; field check advised).

Survey statement (Hindi): नाली और सड़क के काम मंजूरी में अटके हैं
Voter says (English): Town road and drain works are stuck waiting for sanction
Basis: Amar Ujala (16 Jun 2026): Rs 59.20 lakh CC road and drain proposals for Sikandrarau wards (incl. Eidgah Road area and ward 01 in front of the police station) sent to the government for approval; work to begin only after sanction. Status as of this date. Sikandrarao town is counted as inside AC 80 under the namesake-town rule (Wikipedia extent wording 'Hathras Tehsil'; field check advised).

Survey statement (Hindi): सिकंदराराऊ थाने में शिकायत के बाद भी कार्रवाई नहीं हुई, आरोप है
Voter says (English): Police allegedly did not act on a complaint at Sikandrarau station
Basis: Amar Ujala (14 Oct 2026): CJM court in Hathras registered a separate case and summoned the Sikandrarau station in-charge for 17 Oct, after he neither appeared nor filed the inquiry report ordered within 15 days. The complainant alleges police took no action after her complaint; these are her claims as reported. Article has no police response. Station-area membership in AC unconfirmed.

Survey statement (Hindi): जीटी रोड पर सरधला पुल के पास कार-ट्रैक्टर टक्कर में बुजुर्ग की मौत
Voter says (English): A car hit a tractor on GT Road near Sardhla bridge, killing an elderly man
Basis: Hamara Hathras (12 Oct 2026), datelined Sikandrarao: on the Etah-Aligarh GT Road near Sardhla bridge a car hit a paddy-laden tractor; an elderly man died after being taken to the CHC and two others were seriously injured. Single incident, not a pattern; location is near the town. Sikandrarao town is counted as inside AC 80 under the namesake-town rule (Wikipedia extent wording 'Hathras Tehsil'; field check advised).

Survey statement (Hindi): सिकंदराराऊ सीएचसी के सुधार काम का इंतजार है
Voter says (English): Sikandrarau CHC upgrade work was still awaited
Basis: Amar Ujala (22 Feb 2026): work at Sikandrarau CHC 'will start soon' (जल्द); no start date, approval status or amount given. Status after Feb 2026 not found, so this reflects Feb 2026 only and may be out of date.
